title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Prentari / Printer
description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. Félagið vinnur jafnframt með mörgum af öflugustu umbúðaframleiðendum Evrópu til að veita fyrirtækjum heildarlausnir á sviði umbúða. Prentmet Oddi þjónustar meginþorra af kröfuhörðustu fyrirtækjum landsins og hefur gert það í áratugi með hraða, gæði og persónulega þjónustu að leiðarljósi.

eða

Við leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur metnað fyrir gæðum, tæknilega færni og áhuga á að taka þátt í framleiðslu á fyrsta flokks prentverkefnum.

title: Technical Director
description:
CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience.

In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. The ideal candidate brings deep game engine expertise across both runtime and tooling, experience in rendering and graphics, a practical belief in AI-assisted development, and a view of open source as both a near-term execution priority and a long-term strategic advantage.

Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.

The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Your Tasks:

Define and drive the technical direction for CARBON across runtime, graphics, rendering, tools, pipelines, and shared developer technology.

Collaborate closely with the Senior Development Director of Core Technology to translate product vision and priorities into clear technical strategy and execution.

Lead and develop technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, strengthening quality, alignment, and team growth.

Provide architectural guidance across CARBON, ensuring great decisions around performance, scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.

Guide the department in adopting AI-assisted development in practical, high-value ways that improve speed, iteration, and engineering effectiveness.

Shape CARBON's open-source direction to increase platform leverage, accessibility, and long-term relevance.

Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities across the organization.





Your Profile:

Significant senior technical leadership experience in game development.

Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.

Proven ability to define technical direction and align multiple teams around a coherent engineering vision.

People leadership experience across senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers.

Conviction in the value of AI-assisted and open-source development, with the judgment to apply both strategically and practically.

A pragmatic, growth-oriented leadership style with a bias toward learning, experimentation, and solution-finding within real-world constraints.

Experienced enough as an engineer to lead with credibility through technical judgment, architecture, and code review.

Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. description:

The EMEA Service Delivery Lead is a regional leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across all EMEA sites, serving Siemens software engineers across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The Senior Manager directly leads EMEA SD Managers and is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, and execution of global GES programmes within the EMEA region.

Regional Leadership & Operations

Programme Delivery

- Lead EMEA execution of global transformation programmes.- Maintain regional project status, risks, and blockers; provide regular updates to the Global SD Director.- Coordinate with different stakeholders on regional deployments and platform changes.

People Leadership

- Line-manage EMEA SD Managers; set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.- Foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture across geographically dispersed EMEA teams.- Identify talent gaps, succession risks, and training needs within the EMEA SD function.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with EMEA sites stakeholders, business units, and functional managers.- Represent the EMEA region in GES global leadership forums, cross-functional reviews, and planning cycles.- Collaborate with Americas and APAC SD Leads to share best practices and drive global consistency.

Engineering Segment Engagement

- Execute the GES engineering segment engagement model within EMEA; act as the regional point of contact for EMEA segment leads on infrastructure quality, environment needs, and development productivity.- Establish a structured engagement cadence with EMEA engineering segment representatives to gather feedback on CI/CD environments, tooling gaps, and productivity blockers.- Identify and escalate EMEA-specific development environment constraints that impact engineering velocity; collaborate with GOE and Architecture & Standards to drive resolution.- Contribute regional segment insights to GES-wide reporting on developer productivity and service quality.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

Preferred

- Background in software engineering or large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.- Hands-on or supervisory experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack or equivalent platforms).- Exposure to high-performance or grid computing environments — understanding of compute cluster operations, job scheduling, and distributed infrastructure management.- Understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery across EMEA.- Experience managing EMEA-specific regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., data residency, works council processes, GDPR implications for IT operations).- Exposure to software engineering or DevOps environments — direct collaboration with development teams or platform engineering; comfort discussing developer workflow tooling, build pipelines, and environment provisioning.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required at minimum; Managing Professional track highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation — IT governance and control framework awareness.- ISO 27001 awareness — relevant to EMEA regulatory and security compliance considerations.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Foundation or Practitioner.

This role is based in EMEA, with a preference for one of Siemens' DISW established locations.
Regular travel across EMEA sites is expected.

title: Senior Manager, EMEA Service Delivery Lead (f/m/d) - EMEA based (IT-Service-Delivery-Manager/in)
description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The EMEA Service Delivery Lead is a regional leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across all EMEA sites, serving Siemens software engineers across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The Senior Manager directly leads EMEA SD Managers and is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, and execution of global GES programmes within the EMEA region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional Leadership & Operations

- Lead and develop a regional team of SD Managers responsible for engineering support across EMEA sites.- Own regional SLO/SLA performance; ensure targets are met, tracked, and reported consistently.- Drive operational consistency across EMEA sites aligned to global GES standards and Global Operations Excellence (GOE) defined processes.- Act as the primary escalation point for EMEA service issues, customer concerns, and critical incidents.- Ensure CMDB accuracy, asset management, and monitoring compliance across EMEA sites.

Programme Delivery

- Lead EMEA execution of global transformation programmes.- Maintain regional project status, risks, and blockers; provide regular updates to the Global SD Director.- Coordinate with different stakeholders on regional deployments and platform changes.

People Leadership

- Line-manage EMEA SD Managers; set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.- Foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture across geographically dispersed EMEA teams.- Identify talent gaps, succession risks, and training needs within the EMEA SD function.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with EMEA sites stakeholders, business units, and functional managers.- Represent the EMEA region in GES global leadership forums, cross-functional reviews, and planning cycles.- Collaborate with Americas and APAC SD Leads to share best practices and drive global consistency.

Engineering Segment Engagement

- Execute the GES engineering segment engagement model within EMEA; act as the regional point of contact for EMEA segment leads on infrastructure quality, environment needs, and development productivity.- Establish a structured engagement cadence with EMEA engineering segment representatives to gather feedback on CI/CD environments, tooling gaps, and productivity blockers.- Identify and escalate EMEA-specific development environment constraints that impact engineering velocity; collaborate with GOE and Architecture & Standards to drive resolution.- Contribute regional segment insights to GES-wide reporting on developer productivity and service quality.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Substantial relevant experience in service delivery, infrastructure operations, or engineering support, with a demonstrated track record of regional management responsibility across multiple countries.- Proven experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple countries within the EMEA region.- Strong working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and service level management practices.- Experience managing escalations, service performance, and operational governance in a complex enterprise environment.- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional programmes and change within large, matrixed organizations.- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English (additional language proficiency is an advantage).- Solid understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle tracking, and software asset inventory across distributed sites.- Practical knowledge of data center operations, including RDC/colocation environments, physical infrastructure management, and capacity oversight.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup frameworks sufficient to manage and govern SD teams responsible for these environments.- Awareness of vulnerability management practices, including coordination with security teams on remediation tracking and compliance obligations across EMEA sites.- Familiarity with software development practices and the SDLC; ability to engage with engineering teams on environment needs and tooling requirements without deep hands-on development experience.- Awareness of CI/CD concepts and pipeline dependencies; sufficient understanding to identify where GES infrastructure is a bottleneck or enabler for engineering delivery.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering or large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.- Hands-on or supervisory experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack or equivalent platforms).- Exposure to high-performance or grid computing environments — understanding of compute cluster operations, job scheduling, and distributed infrastructure management.- Understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery across EMEA.- Experience managing EMEA-specific regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., data residency, works council processes, GDPR implications for IT operations).- Exposure to software engineering or DevOps environments — direct collaboration with development teams or platform engineering; comfort discussing developer workflow tooling, build pipelines, and environment provisioning.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required at minimum; Managing Professional track highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation — IT governance and control framework awareness.- ISO 27001 awareness — relevant to EMEA regulatory and security compliance considerations.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Foundation or Practitioner.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This role is based in EMEA, with a preference for one of Siemens' DISW established locations.
Regular travel across EMEA sites is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Director, GES Global Service Delivery
Part of: GES Global Service Delivery function, GTI

Why us?
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

description:

BreastCheck - The National Breast Screening Programme BreastCheck, Ireland's National Breast Screening Programme, plays a vital role in the early detection and management of breast cancer. The programme provides free mammograms every two years to women aged 50 to 69, helping to improve survival rates through screening, early diagnosis and advances in treatment. Choose Screening. Together, We Can Make a Difference. Join BreastCheck and become part of a dedicated team committed to improving breast cancer outcomes through excellence in screening, diagnosis and patient care. As a Mammographer (Senior Radiographer), you will make a meaningful contribution to both the quality of the service and the experience of every woman attending BreastCheck. Your work will directly support early cancer detection and help improve health outcomes nationwide. Flexible Opportunities We are currently offering both full-time and part-time positions, with consideration given to flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance. Locations: Applications are invited from suitably qualified candidates to join our Dublin-based screening units: BreastCheck Southern Unit, Infirmary Road, Ballintemple, Cork BreastCheck Western Unit, Newcastle Road, Galway BreastCheck Eccles Unit, Eccles Street, Dublin 7 BreastCheck Merrion Unit, Merrion Road, Dublin 4 BreastCheck operates four screening units located in hospitals and a network of 24 mobile clinics across Ireland. Candidates interested in working within any of these locations are encouraged to apply. Life as a Mammographer (Senior Radiographer) As part of a multidisciplinary breast screening team, you will be responsible for: Producing high-quality mammograms to support the early detection of breast cancer. Conducting quality assurance and monitoring tests on specialist mammography equipment. Ensuring equipment is operated safely and in accordance with established standards and protocols. Delivering a high-quality, compassionate service to women attending BreastCheck. Mammographers play a crucial role in breast cancer screening, combining technical expertise with patient-centred care to achieve the highest possible standards of service delivery. Eligibility Requirements To be considered for this role, candidates must: Be registered as a Radiographer with CORU. Have a minimum of three years' full-time post-qualification experience, or an aggregate equivalent.

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

Capacità di lavorare in autonomia e gestire territori ampi. Esperienza nella gestione di distribuzione e canali agenti. title: DX Head of Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs, EMEA (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Qualitätsmanagement)
description:
Location: MAR EB
Department: SHS DX QT-LS
Mode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time
Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management - PL4 - Position Level 4

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.
We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our team as DX Head of Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs, EMEA (f/m/d), to lead the Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs function across the EMEA region, ensuring compliance, product safety, and operational excellence across commercial operations and customer services.

You will drive and execute regional quality and regulatory strategies, translating requirements into practical business actions that enable market access, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

You will serve as the Quality Representative for assigned legal entities and champion a pragmatic, risk-based approach that balances regulatory compliance with business objectives.

This position can be located at the following locations:

- Marburg (Germany)- Milan (Italy)- Madrid (Spain).

Your tasks and responsibilities:
Quality Management & Continuous Improvement

- Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS) to meet regulatory and business requirements.- Ensure effective execution of Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering processes (e.g., audits, training, documentation, CAPA, nonconformance management).- Identify and mitigate quality risks in commercial operations through structured risk management.- Drive process improvements that increase efficiency, product quality, and customer satisfaction.- Leverage digital tools and data insights to enhance quality performance, transparency, and decision-making.- Ensure inspection readiness across all markets in the region, manage external inspections and internal audits.

Regulatory Strategy & Compliance

- Define and execute the regional regulatory strategy that supports business growth objectives, ensuring timely submissions, approvals, and adherence to country-specific requirements.- Ensure full compliance with internal policies and external regulations, with a strong focus on product safety and market access. Translate regulatory requirements into clear business implications and actionable guidance for leadership teams.- Act as key interface to health authorities and external stakeholders, representing the organization with credibility and impact.

Commercial & Customer Quality

- Establish governance framework, ensuring Commercial teams, Customer Services teams and Business Partners operate in accordance with local requirements and corporate quality standards.- Ensure product integrity and compliance across commercial operations and customer services.- Ensure on time and accurate Post Market Surveillance & Reporting- Partner with customer-facing teams to resolve quality issues and improve the end-to-end customer experience.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

- Embed a strong quality culture focused on continuous improvement and customer-centricity.- Build and lead a high-performing and engaged regional Quality & Regulatory team, driving accountability, capability, and ownership.- Collaborate closely with global Quality and cross-functional teams to align standards, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution.- Lead interactions with local authorities to support regulatory compliance, product lifecycle activities and business continuity across the region.

Your qualifications and experience:

- You have a university degree in life sciences, engineering, or related field.- You have many years of experience in Quality and/or Regulatory Affairs within medical device / pharma, including leadership responsibility.- You have very strong experience with QMS, regulatory submissions/approvals, inspections (e.g., FDA/NMPA), and product safety/compliance frameworks.- You have a proven track record in international, matrix organizations and multi-market environments.- You possess demonstrated leadership across multiple markets in the region.- You have deep expertise in Quality & Regulatory frameworks, including QMS, audits, and authority interactions.- You have the ability to translate quality and regulatory requirements into clear business actions and decisions, including effectively managing quality and compliance risks across direct and indirect markets within the region.

Your attributes and skills:

- You have fluent English language skills.- You have a strong analytical, data-driven, and problem-solving mindset.- You excel by your effective stakeholder management and communication in global, cross-functional settings.- You have the proven ability to lead, develop, and drive performance of high-performing teams.- You showcase high ownership, execution focus, and change agility.

Our team :
Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Our culture:
Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That’s why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.#myabilityshs
Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Klaus Kouril.
We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/en_US/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) to get started.

To all recruitment agencies:
Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. .....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

title: DX Head of Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs, EMEA (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Qualitätsmanagement)
description:
Location: MAR EB
Department: SHS DX QT-LS
Mode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time
Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management - PL4 - Position Level 4

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.
We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our team as DX Head of Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs, EMEA (f/m/d), to lead the Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs function across the EMEA region, ensuring compliance, product safety, and operational excellence across commercial operations and customer services.

You will drive and execute regional quality and regulatory strategies, translating requirements into practical business actions that enable market access, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

You will serve as the Quality Representative for assigned legal entities and champion a pragmatic, risk-based approach that balances regulatory compliance with business objectives.

This position can be located at the following locations:

- Marburg (Germany)- Milan (Italy)- Madrid (Spain).

Your tasks and responsibilities:
Quality Management & Continuous Improvement

- Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS) to meet regulatory and business requirements.- Ensure effective execution of Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering processes (e.g., audits, training, documentation, CAPA, nonconformance management).- Identify and mitigate quality risks in commercial operations through structured risk management.- Drive process improvements that increase efficiency, product quality, and customer satisfaction.- Leverage digital tools and data insights to enhance quality performance, transparency, and decision-making.- Ensure inspection readiness across all markets in the region, manage external inspections and internal audits.

Regulatory Strategy & Compliance

- Define and execute the regional regulatory strategy that supports business growth objectives, ensuring timely submissions, approvals, and adherence to country-specific requirements.- Ensure full compliance with internal policies and external regulations, with a strong focus on product safety and market access. Translate regulatory requirements into clear business implications and actionable guidance for leadership teams.- Act as key interface to health authorities and external stakeholders, representing the organization with credibility and impact.

Commercial & Customer Quality

- Establish governance framework, ensuring Commercial teams, Customer Services teams and Business Partners operate in accordance with local requirements and corporate quality standards.- Ensure product integrity and compliance across commercial operations and customer services.- Ensure on time and accurate Post Market Surveillance & Reporting- Partner with customer-facing teams to resolve quality issues and improve the end-to-end customer experience.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

- Embed a strong quality culture focused on continuous improvement and customer-centricity.- Build and lead a high-performing and engaged regional Quality & Regulatory team, driving accountability, capability, and ownership.- Collaborate closely with global Quality and cross-functional teams to align standards, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution.- Lead interactions with local authorities to support regulatory compliance, product lifecycle activities and business continuity across the region.

Your qualifications and experience:

- You have a university degree in life sciences, engineering, or related field.- You have many years of experience in Quality and/or Regulatory Affairs within medical device / pharma, including leadership responsibility.- You have very strong experience with QMS, regulatory submissions/approvals, inspections (e.g., FDA/NMPA), and product safety/compliance frameworks.- You have a proven track record in international, matrix organizations and multi-market environments.- You possess demonstrated leadership across multiple markets in the region.- You have deep expertise in Quality & Regulatory frameworks, including QMS, audits, and authority interactions.- You have the ability to translate quality and regulatory requirements into clear business actions and decisions, including effectively managing quality and compliance risks across direct and indirect markets within the region.

Your attributes and skills:

- You have fluent English language skills.- You have a strong analytical, data-driven, and problem-solving mindset.- You excel by your effective stakeholder management and communication in global, cross-functional settings.- You have the proven ability to lead, develop, and drive performance of high-performing teams.- You showcase high ownership, execution focus, and change agility.

Our team :
Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.

Our culture:
Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That’s why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success. Check our Careers Site at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.#myabilityshs
Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Klaus Kouril.
We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Click here (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/en_US/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) to get started.

To all recruitment agencies:
Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.

title: Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d) (Industrie-, Produktdesigner/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Industrial Design Engineer

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?

Lebens-Qualität am Arbeitsplatz ist Ihnen wichtig?

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens.

Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden.

Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:

Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion
- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien
- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg
- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte
- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen
- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung
- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen
- Mitwirkung bei Design-Reviews sowie Bewertung von Prototypen und Vorserienteilen hinsichtlich Designqualität und Anmutung
- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen
- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE
- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:

Wissen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden
- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen
- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und Fertigungstechnologie

Wollen

- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis
- Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen
- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung
- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Können

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge
- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)
- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
- Die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Designsprache unserer Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten
- Mitarbeit an internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten
- Arbeiten in einem wirtschaftlich stabilen, werteorientierten Familienunternehmen mit echter Wertschätzung
- Offene Kommunikation und ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander
- Langfristige Perspektiven und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die Stelle ist grundsätzlich an einem unserer Standorte in Deutschland (Stadtallendorf, Bromskirchen, Crottendorf) oder auch an unserem Standort in Italien (Schluderns) zu besetzen.

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständige Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Einkommensvorstellung an lena.dreyer@hoppe.com (https://mailto:lena.dreyer@hoppe.com)

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. title: Orthodontiste (H/F)
description:
Un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire à Rogliano, en Italie, cherche son nouvel orthophoniste H/F pour un CDI.

Les conditions
- CDI
- Temps plein
- Répartition sur 5 ou 6 jours
- 38 heures par semaine

La structure
Vous rejoindrez un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire implanté à Rogliano, à proximité de Cosenza, en Calabre. L'établissement est spécialisé dans le diagnostic, le traitement, la prévention et la réadaptation, avec une prise en charge personnalisée reposant sur des technologies modernes et une équipe multidisciplinaire. En outre, le service de médecine physique et de réadaptation est conventionné avec le Service national de santé italien et prend en charge les pathologies du système musculo-squelettique et du système nerveux. Les patients bénéficient d'examens d'imagerie réalisés sur place et d'un parcours de rééducation intégrant thérapies manuelles et techniques modernes.

La rémunération
- Rémunération selon la convention collective nationale italienne CCNL AIOP RSA, niveau D2

Les missions
- Prendre en charge les troubles de la communication, du langage, de la parole et de la déglutition
- Évaluer les patients et établir des bilans orthophoniques précis
- Mettre en place des programmes de rééducation personnalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et paramédicales dans une approche multidisciplinaire
- Suivre l'évolution des patients et adapter les prises en charge
- Contribuer à la qualité et à la continuité des soins

Les avantages
- Logement pris en charge pendant les 6 premiers mois
- Accompagnement administratif pour faciliter l'installation en Italie
- Contrat à durée indéterminée proposé en priorité avec possibilités de collaboration indépendante selon profil
- Équipe pluridisciplinaire et prise en charge personnalisée des patients
- Accès à l'imagerie et aux techniques de rééducation sur site
- Aménagement du temps de travail sur 5 ou 6 jours selon l'organisation

Le petit truc en plus
Rogliano bénéficie d'un emplacement proche de Cosenza, ville universitaire et culturelle, et offre un accès rapide à la diversité des paysages de la Calabre, entre zones littorales et massifs intérieurs, pour des sorties nature et une qualité de vie agréable.

Orthophoniste diplômé(e), inscrit auprès de la région de Calabre pour l'exercice. Un accompagnement complet sera assuré durant les démarches, sous réserve de la fourniture des documents requis.

title: responsabile di linea di autotrasporti
description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Esperienza: - Consolidata esperienza (almeno 8-10 anni) nel ruolo di Project Manager nel settore navale con un focus sulla costruzione navale o in società del settore marittimo. - Preferibile esperienza presso primari cantieri navali internazionali. - Esperienza su commesse di elevato valore economico e complessità tecnica. Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. Lingue - Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato (seconda lingua preferenziale). Competenze personali - Leadership su team multidisciplinari e forte orientamento al risultato. - Decision making in contesti complessi, pianificazione e gestione priorità. - Flessibilità e disponibilità a trasferte. Cosa offriamo - Inserimento in un contesto industriale dinamico, in sviluppo nel business Nuove Costruzioni Navali. - Ruolo con responsabilità diretta su commesse complesse e strategiche. - CCNL applicabile: CCNL metalmeccanico-industria - Livello di inquadramento: B3/Q - Fascia di RAL da attribuire alla posizione: 60.000€ - 75.000€ - Benefit: mensa, polizza sanitaria e welfare da CCNL. Sede di lavoro: Genova. #LI-GS2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:

•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US.
