title: PhD position at the Department of Geography
description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPhD position

There is a vacancy for a PhD position in System Dynamics at the Department of Geography. The position is within the project INTEGRATOR and for a fixed-term period of 3 years. Starting date is latest 1 April 2027.

System Dynamics Group at the Department of Geography

The System Dynamics group carries out research in several areas. The most important areas are: sustainability transitions, natural resources management, water-energy-food-ecosystems (WEFE) nexus, and model-based learning and communication. The group makes use of a variety of tools and techniques: stakeholder mapping, governance analysis, participatory modeling, non-linear feedback modeling, computer simulation, non-linear model analysis, interactive learning environments and decision-laboratory experiments.


About the project/work tasks:

Description of the INTEGRATOR project

The position is within the EU Horizon Europe project ‘Integrated Innovation Ecosystems for Transformative Nexus Governance towards Enhanced Water Resilience (INTEGRATOR)’. The overarching project objective is to strengthen Europe’s climate-resilient and fair water management by enabling anticipatory, evidence-based decision making at river basin scale under changing climatic and socio-economic conditions, directly supporting the implementation of the EU water strategy. Specific objectives of INTEGRATOR pertaining to this call include: (1) promoting system-wide transformation in water governance and management to strengthen resilience, preparedness, and fair allocation; (2) establishing site-specific, stakeholder-led strategies; (3) creating seasonal and long-term foresight by developing and coupling a suite of models, including data-driven, process-based, and system-dynamics approaches; (4) delivering a digital water intelligence system orchestrated by a prompt compiler translating human language into executable simulations.

INTEGRATOR is built on six case studies in Germany, Greece, Italy, Latvia, Spain and Türkiye with various socio-economic, sectoral development, land use, water quality and water quantity challenges. Among these case studies, two of them are particularly relevant to this call: (1) Ergene River Basin (Türkiye), a 17K km2 watershed and a major industrial and agricultural hub with 2M inhabitants, facing severe pressure on groundwater resources, water quality and allocation. (2) Jucar River Basin – Albufera system in Spain, a highly interconnected river-water-coastal continuum centered on the 210 km2 Albufera Natural Park with high ecological value, facing pressures from intensive irrigated agriculture, and urban and industrial development.

Responsibilities following the position:

The research fellow will use participatory system dynamics modelling and computer simulations to support INTEGRATOR in all work packages (abbreviated as WP), with a concentrated focus on two WPs: WP3 (Participatory Co-Design for Resilient and Equitable Water Solutions using a Decision Theatre Approach) is going to strengthen inclusive and transformational governance through structured participatory process in the INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres (DTs). More specifically, WP3 will deal with stakeholder mapping, problem co-definition, participatory scenario analysis and policy exploration embedded in INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres Approach (DTA). WP6 (Digital Water Intelligence System and the HydroFellow) is going to provide a Digital Water Intelligence System (DWIS) and a prompt compiler, integrating multisource information, including models and model generated data. More specifically, WP6 will work on integrated hydrological and system dynamics modeling, site-specific digital twin development and integration, and the prompt compiler HydroFellow development through interaction with the DTs. The research fellow will be working on the Ergene and Albufera case studies to fundamentally support the activities under WP3 and WP6 through systems thinking, dynamic systems modeling and computer simulations.


Qualifications and personal qualities:
  • The applicant must hold a master’s degree in System Dynamics or another discipline with a strong system, modeling and simulation focus. The master’s degree must have been completed by the application deadline.
  • The requirements are generally a grade B or better on the Master thesis and for the master’s degree in total.
  • Applicants must demonstrate a strong interest in socio-economic-hydrological scenario building; experience in participatory model-building is desirable.
  • Applicants must have strong quantitative and computational foundations.
  • Teaching assistance experience in the field of System Dynamics will be considered an advantage.
  • The applicant must be proficient in both written and oral English. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Turkish languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should have experience of working as a member of a multidisciplinary and multicultural research team and demonstrate good collaborative skills.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary working, linking social/economic and environmental sciences, is desirable.
  • Personal and relational qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also count when evaluating the candidates.
  • The place of work for this position is Bergen, and the work requires that you are physically present at the Department of Geography on a daily basis.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. 


About the PhD position:

The duration of the PhD position is 3 years. 

About the PhD training:

As a PhD research fellow, you will take part in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences, UiB. The programme corresponds to a period of three years and leads to the PhD degree. To be eligible for admission you must normally have an educational background corresponding to a master’s degree with a scope of 120 ECTS credits, which builds on a bachelor’s degree with a scope of 180 ECTS credits (normally 2 + 3 years), or an integrated master’s degree with a scope of 300 ECTS credits (5 years). Master’s degrees must normally include an independent work of a minimum of 30 ECTS credits. It is expected that the topic of the master’s degree is connected to the academic field to which you are seeking admission.


We can offer:
  • Salary as PhD (code 1017) NOK 593 700,- per year. Automatic salary increases for up to 3 years with a 3% annual increase 
  • A good and professionally challenging working environment
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Project proposal:

A research proposal of maximum 2500 words (excluding reference list) must accompany the application. The project description should present the topic, the research questions(s) and choice of theory and methods. It should also include a progress plan for the different parts of the project. The research proposal must also include a short description of how the applicant envisions a fit with the INTEGRATOR project. Admittance to the PhD programme will be based on the research proposal. The faculty has prepared a guide for writing project descriptions.


Your application must include:
  • A cover letter including a brief account of your research interests and motivation for applying for the position
  • The names and contact information for two reference persons. One of them must be the main advisor for the master's thesis or equivalent thesis
  • Project proposal
  • CV
  • Transcripts and diplomas showing completion of the bachelor's and master's degrees.
  • Relevant certificates/references
  • A list of academic publications
  • Academic publications that you want to submit for assessment (including your master’s thesis or equivalent)
  • If you have a master's degree from an institution outside of the Nordic countries, or a 2-year discipline- based master's degree (or the equivalent) in a subject area other than the one associated with the application, you may later in the application process be asked to submit an overview of the syllabus for the degree you have completed

The application and appendices with certified translations into English or a Scandinavian language must be uploaded at Jobbnorge following the link on this page marked “Apply for this job”.

Closing date: November 1, 2026.

Applications submitted without a project proposal or applications sent as e-mails will not be considered. Only submitted documents will be subjected to an expert assessment.


General information:

Detailed information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Ali K. Saysel, ali.saysel@uib.no.

Practical questions regarding the application procedures, please contact the HR section at: personal.svfa@uib.no. 

Appointed research fellows will be admitted to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences. Questions about the programme may be directed to Adviser Elina Troscenko, elina.troscenko@uib.no

title: Vil du bli en del av teamet vårt? Vi søker nå kranførere og veimontører!
description:
Har du praktisk sans, liker fysisk arbeid og trives når dagene er varierte – uansett vær og vind? Da kan det fort være deg vi ser etter!

Oppdragsmengden vokser, og vi trenger flere dyktige folk som vil være med å skape trygghet ute på veiene og rundt byggeplasser. Hos oss jobber du med alt innen arbeidsvarsling og trafikksikring – en jobb som virkelig betyr noe.

Hvem er du?

Du kjenner deg igjen i dette:

  • Du liker å jobbe praktisk og er ikke redd for å ta i et tak
  • Du er løsningsorientert, pålitelig og har stolthet i faget
  • Du trives både selvstendig og sammen med kolleger
  • Du liker å jobbe ute – i sol, regn, vind og snø
  • Du setter alltid sikkerheten først
  • Du har førerkort C, og sertifikat G8 og G11
  • Fordel med CE

Arbeidshverdagen hos oss

Ingen dag er lik – og det er nettopp det mange av våre ansatte elsker! Du vil blant annet jobbe med:

  • Utsett av forvarslinger samt sperring på vei
  • TMA-kjøring
  • Midlertidig langsgående sikring
  • Permanent montering av skilt, portaler og andre installasjoner
  • Midlertidig skilting
  • Områdesikring rundt byggeplasser

Dette er en jobb for deg som liker å se konkret resultat av arbeidet ditt – hver eneste dag.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Solid opplæring og gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Et trygt, inkluderende og uformelt arbeidsmiljø
  • Varierte dager ute i felt sammen med mange erfarne og engasjerte kolleger som brenner for faget 
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser (tariff) 
  • Fast og forutsigbar ansettelse i et selskap med store vekstambisjoner for fremtiden

 

Klar for å bli en del av et solid og trivelig team?

Vi vil gjerne høre fra deg!
Send inn en søknad – eller ta kontakt om du har spørsmål!

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

title: Er du god med mennesker og liker å finne de beste løsningene for kunden?
description:
Toyota Haugesund søker kunderådgiver

Du trenger ikke å kunne alt om bil for å lykkes som kunderådgiver hos Toyota Haugesund. Det viktigste er at du liker mennesker, trives med ansvar og motiveres av å skape gode kundeopplevelser.

Som kunderådgiver blir du bindeleddet mellom kundene våre og verkstedet. Du følger kunden gjennom hele besøket, fra bilen leveres inn til nøklene gis tilbake, og sørger for god kommunikasjon og en trygg opplevelse underveis.

Du får en variert arbeidshverdag hvor kundekontakt kombineres med koordinering, salg og administrative oppgaver. Noen dager handler det om å finne den beste løsningen for en kunde, andre ganger om å sørge for at deler er på plass, følge opp en verkstedordre eller sikre at kunden vet hva som skjer med bilen.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Ta imot kunder ved innlevering og utlevering av bil
  • Veilede og følge opp kunder gjennom verkstedbesøket
  • Identifisere behov og tilby relevante verkstedtjenester
  • Følge opp deler og bestillinger
  • Håndtere ordre og fakturering
  • Sørge for god kommunikasjon mellom kunde og verksted
  • Bidra til at kundene våre får en best mulig opplevelse
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som naturlig setter kunden først. Du er god til å lytte, forstå behov og finne løsninger, samtidig som du klarer å holde oversikt når det er mye som skjer.

Du trives med mennesker og kommuniserer godt med ulike typer kunder. Samtidig har du interesse for bil og en teknisk forståelse som gjør at du raskt kan sette deg inn i kundens behov og problemstillinger.

Erfaring fra bilbransjen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du jobbet med kundeservice, rådgivning eller salg og kjenner deg igjen i rollen, ønsker vi også å høre fra deg.

Vi tror du:

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner og liker kundekontakt
  • Har interesse for bil og god teknisk forståelse
  • Er serviceinnstilt og opptatt av gode kundeopplevelser
  • Er strukturert og løsningsorientert
  • Har god arbeidskapasitet og tar ansvar
  • Er komfortabel med IT som arbeidsverktøy
  • Trives med både selvstendig arbeid og samarbeid
Hvorfor Toyota Haugesund?

Hos Toyota Haugesund blir du en del av en komplett bilforhandler hvor salg, verksted, karosseri, lakkering, klargjøring, deler og dekk er samlet under samme tak.

Du får jobbe med en av verdens mest kjente bilmerkevarer og blir en del av et fagmiljø hvor kvalitet, kontinuerlig forbedring og gode kundeopplevelser står sentralt.

Hos oss får du blant annet:

  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Opplæring og faglig utvikling gjennom Toyotas opplæringsprogrammer
  • God støtte fra dyktige kollegaer
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste og tilgang til personalhytte
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på gode arbeidsforhold
  • Muligheten til å utvikle deg i en solid virksomhet og en bilbransje i stor utvikling
Om Toyota Haugesund

Toyota Haugesund er en del av Jæger Automobil AS og er en komplett bilforhandler på Haugalandet. Fra anlegget i Salhusvegen tilbyr vi blant annet nye og brukte biler, verkstedtjenester, deler og tilbehør, dekkhotell, karosseri, lakkering og klargjøring.

Jæger Automobil er en del av Jægergruppen, Vestlandets største bilforhandler, og representerer Toyota, Lexus, BMW og MINI. Konsernet har over 250 ansatte og en årlig omsetning på 1,6 milliarder kroner.

title: PhD Fellow in Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Arctic Railway Infrastructure Monitoring
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS NARVIK
description:
The position

A PhD position is available at the Department of Electrical Engineering (IET), Faculty of Engineering Sciences and Technology, UiT The Arctic University of Norway. The position is within the field of distributed fibre-optic sensing for railway infrastructure monitoring, with particular emphasis on the use of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) for monitoring railway infrastructure and natural hazards along the Ofoten Line.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD programme is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25 % each year and will consist of teaching and other duties. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Narvik. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The position’s field of research

The position is associated with a new research initiative at UiT on intelligent monitoring and resilience of railway and transport infrastructure in Arctic environments that aims to address how distributed sensing, fibre-optic monitoring, environmental observations, drone- and satellite-based data, operational infrastructure datasets, and/or machine learning can be used to support real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, geohazard detection, and safer railway operations. The initiative is a collaboration between the Department of Electrical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Computational Engineering, and the Department of Geosciences.
Research infrastructure is provided via existing data, sensor networks, and established field sites along the Ofoten Line and new initiatives associated with the Arctic Test Arena project.

Railway infrastructure in Arctic and Nordic regions is increasingly exposed to harsh weather, heavy traffic loads, climate-related hazards, and growing operational demands. Current railway monitoring systems still rely largely on manual inspections and periodic measurements. This makes it challenging to detect early signs of infrastructure degradation, vibration-related damage, geohazards, snow avalanches, rockfalls, landslides, track irregularities, wheel defects, bearing faults, and people and animals on the track.

The PhD project will investigate how existing fibre-optic cable infrastructure along the Ofoten line railway, one of Norway’s most strategically important and climate-exposed railways, can be used as a distributed sensor network for continuous infrastructure monitoring. Standard optical fibres will be used as dense arrays of vibration sensors, making it possible to measure dynamic strain and acoustic disturbances along many kilometres of fibre with down to metre-scale spatial resolution – a technique coined Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). The long-term ambition is to enable high-resolution, real-time warning and decision support for railway operations and maintenance.

The successful candidate will work on developing, testing, modelling, and validating methods for DAS-based monitoring of railway infrastructure and surrounding terrain. The work can include physics-based modelling of e.g., various events and wave propagation through different media, signal processing, large-scale data analysis, algorithm development and potentially also field work.

The applicants must present a description outlining the academic basis of the PhD project. The project description shall not exceed 2 pages, including reference lists/figures/tables if relevant. It must include a description of the topic, research question(s) and a reasoning of the choices. It should also indicate the methodologies to be used. The final project description will be developed in cooperation with the supervisor.


Qualifications

This position requires a master’s degree or equivalent in applied mathematics, signal processing, physics, geophysics, civil engineering (electrical, geotechnical, structural, environmental, transportation, construction, computer etc.), data/computer science or similar. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply.

Applicants must document good English skills and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.

The candidate should have expertise in data analysis and be able to implement data analysis tools in a suitable programming language. It is also advantageous with knowledge and/or capabilities in one or more of the following topics:

  • Signal processing
  • Physical/geophysical modelling
  • Computer science
  • Geohazards
  • Waves and fields
  • Material science

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. Evaluation of the candidate is not only based on the candidates track record in education, but other experiences that can be relevant for the PhD work. This includes teaching, practical experience with e.g., railway infrastructure and/or other relevant work or activities. The project description will also be considered. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Can contribute to a positive and productive working environment
  • Are able to work both independently and in groups on defined research topics
  • Have good work ethics

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.


Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Engineering Science and Technology and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

In order to gain admission to the programme, applicants with a background from a Norwegian institution should have a minimum grade of C on their master thesis and a weighted grade average of 3.0 for the last two years of their master programme. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here. 

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.


Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.


We offer
  • A dynamic and expanding research environment 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A supportive academic community with committed colleagues
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests (max 1 page)
  • CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • 2-3 references with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works
  • Project description  (max 2 pages references included)

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis and a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If your diplomas and transcripts are written in a different language, you must upload both an English/Scandinavian translation and the originals. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. Applications and supporting documentation are only accepted via Jobbnorge and must be submitted within the application deadline.


Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 


General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment. After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilize our location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.

UiT has approximately 18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta, Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT's activities. Participation, co-determination, transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous - closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments.

Det viktigste for oss er at du har lyst til å jobbe, møter opp når du skal og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø. Erfaring fra butikk er en fordel, men ikke et krav – riktig innstilling og vilje til å lære betyr mye.

title: Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.
description:
Starting in September 2026, we are looking for a long-term employee for the position of Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE COMPANY

During the summer season, we operate an outdoor activity base offering rafting, canyoning and mountain carts. In summer 2026, we welcomed 3,621 guests. The summer season runs from mid-May to mid-September.

During the winter season, we operate a small ski centre with the longest toboggan run in Norway and a ski rental service. In winter 2026, we welcomed 4,774 guests. The winter season runs from mid-December to mid-April.

During both seasons, guests can stay in our apartment or lavvo camp (maximum capacity of 49 people), and enjoy the facilities (sauna, hot tub, party lavvo and gas grill).

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Management of the employee team:

    • Summer season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), guide team for rafting, canyoning and mountain carts, head guide (responsible for the operation of activities), drivers and maintenance -- approximately 15 people in total

    • Winter season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), ski lift operators, snow groomer and maintenance -- approximately 5 people in total

  • Manual and administrative management, development and maintenance of the base

  • Practical day-to-day operation of the base and its activities

  • Administration and preparation of materials for accounting

  • Management of company assets (buildings, vehicles and activity equipment)

  • Cooperation with the Finance Director, Booking and Marketing departments

EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

Start: September 2026

Location: Dagali Fjellpark, Perstulvegen 100, 3588 Dagali, Norway

Working hours & remuneration

  • Number of working days during the winter season (mid-December -- mid-April): approximately 101

  • Number of working days during the summer season (mid-May -- mid-September): approximately 107

  • To be adjusted according to the candidate's abilities and mutual agreement.

Compensation: approximately NOK 220/hour, or alternatively a fixed salary based on the expected number of working hours, subject to agreement.

In the case of a long-term cooperation (after the trial period and with the agreement of both parties), we can discuss a fixed salary and performance-based bonus.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Management skills

  • Assertive attitude and advanced communication skills

  • Experience working in tourism

  • Positive attitude towards outdoor activities

  • Good knowledge of English

  • Willingness to stay in Dagali (Geilo) long-term and continuously from mid-December to mid-April and from mid-May to mid-September

  • Good computer skills and ability to handle administrative tasks

  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions when necessary (snow, frost, wind, rain)

  • Responsibility, independence and attention to detail

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Long-term cooperation

  • Varied and interesting work

  • Working in the mountains and in a natural environment

  • Opportunity to participate in the development of the company

  • Benefits:

    • Free accommodation at the workplace during the first season; accommodation for future seasons by agreement.

    • Assistance with obtaining an ID number and tax card

    • Free rental of winter equipment for personal leisure activities

title: PhD Fellow in Railway Resilience and Operational Decision Support
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS NARVIK
description:
The position

A PhD position is available at the Department of Building, Energy and Material Technology (IBEM), Faculty of Engineering Science and Technology (IVT).

The candidate will work in Building, Energy and Material Technology (BEaM) research group. The research group conducts applied research in fields such as sustainable buildings, renewable energy technologies, material technology, environmental sustainability, resilience and vulnerability and decision support systems.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD programme is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25 % each year and will consist of teaching and other duties. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Narvik. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project

The proposed PhD project addresses a critical challenge in modern railway systems: maintaining operational stability under increasing environmental stress, aging infrastructure, and growing traffic demand. In Norway, railway infrastructure operates under demanding climatic conditions, due to subzero temperatures. This PhD project aims to develop an integrated, risk-informed and resource-aware framework that links infrastructure robustness, environmental vulnerability, and operational decision-making. The project is grounded in the concept that railway performance is not only determined by asset condition, but by the interaction between hazard exposure, infrastructure response, and the ability to manage and recover operations under resource constraints.

The research is structured around three closely connected components: (a) hazard-driven vulnerability and exposure mapping; (b) resource-aware resilience and operational impact modelling and (c) risk-informed decision support for control-room environment. The project will be carried out in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders in the railway sector, and results will be validated in operational.

The project is expected to deliver both scientific advancements and practical contributions to the railway sector for implementation to achieve robust and resilient railway operations regardless disruptions due to extreme weather or human factors.

The applicant must submit a short proposal (max 2 pages) describing his/her understanding of the problem and proposal to solve the problem.


Qualifications

Required qualifications & educational background

  • Master’s degree (or equivalent) in civil engineering, industrial engineering, transport/railway engineering, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, or other relevant disciplines.
  • Strong academic record and demonstrated ability for independent research and analytical work.
  • Solid foundation in quantitative methods (e.g. statistics, modelling, optimisation, or system analysis).
  • Background in one or more of the following areas:
    • Infrastructure or transport systems
    • Risk, reliability, or resilience analysis
    • Data analysis and computational modelling / programming (e.g. Python, MATLAB, R or similar)
    • Ability to develop and apply models of complex systems, simulation and stochastic modelling, optimisation under constraints

Desirable skills and training in one or more will be advantageous

  • Knowledge of transport or railway systems.
  • Familiarity with risk-informed decision-making frameworks and ability to translate analytical results into practical decision-support insights.
  • Ability to apply system-level thinking, linking infrastructure performance, environmental conditions, and operations.
  • Experience with data-driven modelling or machine learning.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively, including engagement with external stakeholders.
  • Previous publication(s) on a relevant topic is meritorious.

The application must include documentation of all training, knowledge, skills and GPA (grade point average). If the documents are not in English, translation rules for the European Standardized Character System must be followed. Applicants must document fluency in English and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma. Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language will be preferred.

We are looking for candidates who has good communication skills and contributes to a team and working environment.

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.


Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the  Faculty of Engineering Science and Technology and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

In order to gain admission to the programme, applicants with a background from a Norwegian institution should have a minimum grade of C on their master thesis and a weighted grade average of 3.0 for the last two years of their master programme. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here. 

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.


Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests (max 1 page).

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis and a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants.

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 


General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. The increasing penetration of distributed energy resources, electric vehicles, and flexible loads is making distribution networks more dynamic and challenging to operate using conventional voltage regulation methods. To address growing voltage variability and the limitations of traditional controllers, this PhD project proposes the development of advanced AI-based, automated, and intelligent fast-control strategies for voltage control in future distribution grids with high uncertainty and dynamic environments. 

The project will consider various uncertain scenarios and will utilize and develop advanced AI-based control and management strategies capable of managing multiple voltage-regulating devices and DERs through scalable control structures. Advanced machine learning, reinforcement learning, and agent-based optimization techniques will be developed to reduce voltage deviations, cut active power curtailment, and improve system adaptability under diverse operating conditions. The hierarchical design will combine rapid local decision-making with system-wide supervisory control to ensure both quick responsiveness and overall coordination.

A comprehensive validation framework will be established, beginning with offline simulations using detailed distribution network models to test and benchmark the proposed control strategies. These developments will then be evaluated using real-time digital simulators for hardware-in-the-loop experiments. Additionally, a Cyberphysical co-simulation environment will be used to assess controller performance under realistic communication and control conditions.

The expected outcome is a robust, intelligent, and practical VC solution that enhances voltage regulation, improves grid flexibility, and supports higher renewable penetration in future smart distribution networks.

title: Work as a GP in scenic Western Norway
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Europe. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to work in a well-organised GP practice with experienced colleagues, close access to specialist healthcare, and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities?

On behalf of a municipality in Vestland County, we are recruiting a family medicine specialist for a permanent position in a modern and well-established GP practice.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive professional environment where quality of care, collaboration, and continuity for patients are highly valued. The practice is located in a scenic area of Western Norway, surrounded by mountains, lakes, and fjords, with easy access to both outdoor activities and urban amenities.

About the position

You will join a GP practice consisting of three experienced GPs and one resident doctor. The available patient list currently includes approximately 800 patients, with the possibility of gradually increasing the list size if desired.

The municipality places great emphasis on creating a positive working environment and maintaining a strong professional community with skilled colleagues and experienced support staff.

The position includes:

    Responsibility for your own patient list
    Diagnosis, treatment, and long-term follow-up of patients of all ages
    Preventive healthcare and chronic disease management
    Up to 20% municipal medical duties
    Participation in an organised out-of-hours emergency service rotation

Emergency care services

The municipality participates in an intermunicipal emergency care collaboration involving five municipalities. The emergency clinic is located next to the local hospital and operates from dedicated facilities.

    The service includes responsibility for:
    Out-of-hours emergency care
    Municipal acute care beds (KAD)
    Emergency medical communication centre
    The clinic is staffed by qualified healthcare personnel around the clock, providing a well-supported working environment during emergency shifts.

We offer

    Permanent full-time position
    Annual salary of approx. NOK 1.6 million for specialists, plus additional compensation for emergency service duties
    A well-established GP practice with experienced colleagues
    Strong professional support and collaboration
    Good opportunities for professional development and continuing education
    Assistance with relocation and practical arrangements when moving to Norway
    Free Norwegian language training
    Support throughout the authorisation process

About the area

The position is located in a municipality in Vestland County, one of Norway's most spectacular regions. The area is known for its fjords, mountains, glaciers, and excellent opportunities for hiking, skiing, cycling, and fishing.

The community offers schools, cultural activities, sports facilities, and a wide range of local services. The location also provides good transport connections to larger towns and cities in Western Norway.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

    Are specialists in family medicine / general practice (GP)
    Hold a valid medical licence and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
    Have good English language skills
    Are motivated to learn Norwegian
    Have good communication and collaboration skills
    Wish to establish a long-term career and life in Norway

Why Norway?

General practitioners play a central role in the Norwegian healthcare system and are responsible for the long-term follow-up of their own patients. Norwegian healthcare is characterised by high professional standards, collaborative working environments, and a high degree of professional autonomy.

Norway also offers excellent opportunities to combine a medical career with a balanced lifestyle, family life, and access to nature.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the position and life in Norway. Please contact us for a confidential conversation or send us your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: McDonald's Otta søker deg som vil mestre høyt tempo sammen med gode kollegaer
description:
Er du lei av ulike stereotypiske holdninger? Vil du jobbe et sted hvor du kan være deg selv og bli satt pris på akkurat slik DU er? Hos McDonald's vet vi at ulike mennesker gjør det best i team, hos oss kan du selvsagt være deg selv!

Hva kan du forvente hos oss?

  • God opplæring: Du trenger ikke å kunne alt fra dag én. Vi lærer deg å håndtere stress, jobbe i team og levere kundeservice med et smil (ja, selv på en hektisk fredagskveld)
  • God oppfølging: Du får tilbakemeldinger som hjelper deg å bli enda bedre – og skryt når du fortjener det
  • Rettferdig lønn: Vi betaler tariff
  • Fleksible arbeidstider: Tilpasset deg og ditt behov
  • En meningsfull jobb: McDonald’s tar sosialt samfunnsansvar og jobber kontinuerlig med aktiviteter for en mer bærekraftig drift, som for eksempel at vi fjerner all plast fra emballasjen vår innen dette året
  • En arbeidsplass der alle får muligheten til å være seg selv: din personlighet betyr mer enn din CV
  • Fri når du har fri: Vi skjønner at du har et liv utenfor jobben

  • Du har sterke samarbeidsevner (teamwork er vår superkraft)
  • Du klarer å holde hodet kaldt under press (det er helt avgjørende når grillen streiker en fredagskveld)
  • Du elsker å lære og oppleve mestring (den følelsen du får når du klarer noe du trodde ikke var mulig)
  • Du er flink til å kommunisere og samarbeide, både med kollegaer og kunder (når det koker på kjøkkenet er din samarbeidsevne avgjørende)
  • Du trives med kundebehandling, matlaging, rydding og renhold (tiden går fort når du jobber hos oss)

Hos oss får du dette – og litt til.

Vi gir deg muligheten til å lære ferdigheter, som stressmestring, som ikke bare gir deg en fordel i arbeidslivet, men som også vil komme til nytte i livet ellers.

Er du klar for å bli en del av et team som setter pris på mangfold og individuell utvikling?

Vi er klare til å ønske deg velkommen – og muligens til og med dele en Big Mac!

Velkommen til McDonald’s!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hos McDonald's kan vi tilby deg en hektisk hverdag med mange nye utfordringer. Hos oss er ingen dager like og vi prøver til enhver tid å overgå gjestenes forventninger. Arbeidsoppgavene består av kundebehandling, matlaging og vasking/rydding av lokaler.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Soft Matter
description:
About the position

Position as PhD Research Fellow in chemistry/physical chemistry available at Department of Chemistry.

The fellowship period is three years. 
A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25% of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

Starting date: as soon as possible, no later than January 1st, 2027.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Chemistry in the Life Science Building at the University of Oslo, Gaustad, Oslo.


Job description

This position is part of the convergence environment PERMEATE – Peptides for Membrane Targeting and Synergistic Drug Delivery. Convergence environments are interdisciplinary research initiatives that aim to address major challenges in health and the environment. They are funded by UiO’s interdisciplinary strategic area UiO:Life Science.
PERMEATE focuses on overcoming cell membrane barriers using peptides to enable targeted delivery of therapeutic molecules. The project adopts a multidisciplinary approach, integrating expertise from computational sciences, chemistry, pharmacy, biology, and medicine. The convergence environment comprises three PhD positions and one postdoctoral position.

PhD Position within PERMEATE
We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to work on peptide-membrane interactions and the development of lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) for applications in both cancer therapy and the treatment of bacterial infections. The work will be situated at the interface of (bio)physical chemistry, soft matter, and organic chemistry. The candidate should have a strong interest in multidisciplinary research and a clear motivation for interdisciplinary collaboration.

The PhD project will focus on:

  • Characterizing and understanding the dynamical and structural effects of different peptides on a range of membrane systems
  • Developing strategies to formulate and prepare building blocks for stable LNPs through organic synthesis and click chemistry.
  • Use broad advanced instrumentation for X-ray/neutron scattering studies, surface studies (QCM-D, AFM), analytics (SEC-MALS/A4F) as well as spectroscopy (NMR/fluorescence/UV/vis) – all supported by quantitative data analysis.

The PhD candidate will contribute to bridging research activities across groups based in:
Pharmacy, Theoretical chemistry, Medicine, Microbiology and Biophysics and will play an active role in fostering collaboration within the PERMEATE convergence environment.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physical chemistry, biophysics or physics or related fields  
  • Documented practical wet lab experience and basic skills in organic chemistry 
  • Documented basic knowledge and some practical experience in programming and numerical methods.
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability in developing, executing and analysing data from experimental lab work
  • Documented experience within quantitative data analysis and interpretation
  • Documented experience within soft matter and (bio)polymer science 
  • Documented experience in organic synthesis and characterization
  • Previous expertise in nanostructural characterization tools, in particular scattering techniques will be given weight
  • Earlier experience in soft matter, synthesis, conjugation chemistry and click chemistry will be considered positively

Language requirement:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Strong motivation for research and able to work proactively in a multidisciplinary team 
  • Ability to work independently in a self-driven manner
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • A cover letter specific for this position - statement of motivation and research interests in the specific scope of the current position
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor and Master degree diploma (see below)
  • Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Department of Chemistry is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

title: Ready to make an impact on the green energy transition? Join Voith Hydro AS as our next HSE Manager!
description:
The Voith Hydro Division is a worldwide provider of hydropower technology and services. In Norway, Voith Hydro AS acts as a turnkey supplier of new hydropower facilities, power plant control systems, and modernization projects for turbines and generators, as well as comprehensive service and maintenance solutions. The company employs 173 people across its offices in Oslo, Trondheim, and Fredrikstad and reports annual revenues of NOK 580 million.

Voith Hydro AS is actively engaged in a broad portfolio of hydropower projects throughout Norway and has a strong outlook for the future. As part of our continued growth, we are expanding our HSE organization and are looking for an HSE Manager to join our team. Working in close collaboration with our existing HSE Manager, you will play a key role in promoting a strong safety culture and supporting the successful delivery of our projects.

Position: HSE Manager- Norway

Reporting Line: Managing Director Voith Hydro AS, and functionally to the Regional Head of HSE.

Role Purpose

The HSE Manager is responsible for implementing and continuously improving the VHE HSE Management System within the Norwegian organization and ensuring safe, compliant and efficient execution of all operational activities.

The role acts as the primary HSE advisor to the Managing Director, drives a Zero Incident culture, maintains a strong field presence, and ensures HSE is fully integrated into project delivery, field service, workshop activities and business operations.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Culture

  • Drive a proactive safety culture across the the company.

  • Lead implementation of VHE HSE standards, Life Saving Rules and STOP Work Authority.

  • Conduct regular sites, workshop and field service visits.

  • Challenge unsafe conditions, behaviors and decisions.

  • Coach leaders and employees to improve HSE performance.

  • Local functional leadership of HSE coordination function

Operational HSE Management

  • Ensure effective management of operational risks.

  • Verify implementation of critical risk controls.

  • Support safe execution of high-risk activities.

  • Manage contractor HSE performance.

Incident Management & Compliance

  • Lead incident investigations and root cause analyses.

  • Ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.

  • Develop meaningful Lessons Learned.

  • Ensure compliance with legal, customer and VHE HSE requirements.

  • Maintain and improve the local HSE Management System.

Performance & Reporting

  • Monitor and report HSE performance.

  • Identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.

  • Provide transparent reporting to the Managing Director and Regional Head of HSE.

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

  • Degree in Engineering, HSE or related discipline.

  • NEBOSH IGC or equivalent.

  • Minimum 8 years HSE experience within hydropower, offshore oil & gas, offshore wind, energy, OEM, EPC or heavy industry.

  • Experience leading incident investigations and contractor management.

  • The successful candidate must demonstrate strong proficiency in Norwegian, both written and spoken, as this is essential for carrying out the responsibilities of the position.

Preferred

  • NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent Level 6 qualification.

  • ISO 45001 Lead Auditor qualification.

  • Formal incident investigation training.

  • Experience within major projects or high-risk operational environments.

Success Profile

The successful candidate:

  • Demonstrates visible HSE leadership and strong field presence.

  • Ensures uncompromised safe execution across all operations.

  • Leads high-quality investigations and organizational learning.

  • Acts as a trusted advisor and challenger to management.

  • Promotes a proactive Zero Incident culture.

  • Drives continuous improvement and sustainable HSE performance.

  • Demonstrates a collaborative, accountable and "walk the talk" leadership style

What We Offer

  • A meaningful career in the hydropower industry, supporting Norway's renewable energy sector. Our solutions ensure the reliable operation of critical infrastructure and contribute to the generation of clean, renewable energy.

  • The opportunity to make a real impact on how we develop, standardize, and modernize solutions for the hydropower plants of the future.

  • Interesting and challenging responsibilities in a multidisciplinary environment within hydropower and renewable energy.

  • Exciting professional and career development opportunities within a large international organization.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment, combining strong technical expertise with an excellent team culture. We offer modern office facilities and a variety of social activities.

  • Competitive salary and benefits.

Diversity and Inclusion

We believe that diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences, competencies, and perspectives, as we believe this contributes to better solutions and stronger teams.

Background Check

In accordance with regulations related to power-sector security and access to sensitive information, Voith Hydro AS uses Semac to conduct background checks on employees. Employment is therefore subject to a satisfactory background check.

Location

The preferred place of work is one of our offices in:

Oslo (Østre Aker Vei 90)

Trondheim (Sluppenvegen 25)

Travel Requerements

As part of this role, you should expect regular travel to customer sites and project's locations across Norway, as well as periodic travel between our office locations.

Industry Background

Experience from the hydropower industry is considered an advantage; however, candidates with relevant HSE experience from other industrial, energy, engineering, or infrastructure sectors are also encouraged to apply.

If this opportunity sounds like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment portal. Please note that both your CV and application must be submitted in English.

For further information about the position, please contact: Siv-Anita Nilsen HR Manager Norway Phone: +47 920 64 300

Ready for your next challenge? Submit your CV and application and join us in shaping the future of hydropower.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Voith Group is a global technology company. With its broad portfolio of systems, products, services and digital applications, Voith sets standards in the markets of energy, paper, raw materials and transport & automotive. Founded in 1867, the company today has around 22,000 employees, sales of € 5,2 billion and locations in over 60 countries worldwide and is thus one of the larger family-owned companies in Europe.

title: MAX  søker skiftleder

Ambisjonen er den samme som for 50 år siden – med de beste råvarene skal vi servere de beste hamburgerne.

Vi vil bli verdens beste burgerkjede, og vi vet at veien dit går gjennom engasjerte ledere, sterke team, god service og virkelig gode burgere. Nå søker vi deg som vil ta første steg i lederkarrieren din og være med på å skape serviceopplevelser i verdensklasse ved hvert besøk. 

Som skiftleder hos MAX er du en nøkkelperson i restaurantens daglige arbeid. Du leder teamet på stedet, sørger for at gjestene får best mulig opplevelse, og at restauranten alltid leverer på topp – både når det gjelder kvalitet, tempo og service. Du har oversikt over hele virksomheten: fra kjøkken og kasse til servering og uteområder. Sammen med kollegaene dine skaper du en arbeidsplass der arbeidsglede, fellesskap og utvikling står i sentrum. 

Vi søker deg som er serviceinnstilt, trives i høyt tempo og har en naturlig evne til å inspirere andre. Du er et forbilde som leder ved å være til stede, engasjert og løsningsorientert. Du liker å se kollegaene dine vokse og utvikle seg, og du forstår viktigheten av alltid å sette gjesten i fokus. 

 

Hovedarbeidsoppgaver 

  • Lede og coache teamet i det daglige arbeidet 
  • Sikre at gjestene får en serviceopplevelse i verdensklasse

  • Ha oversikt over kjøkken, kasse, restaurantområde og uteområde 
  • Bidra til at restauranten er ren, ryddig og innbydende 
  • Jobbe aktivt med våre verdier: Mot, Lidenskap og Fellesskap 

 

Hva tilbyr vi? 

  • En jobb med høyt tempo og gode utviklingsmuligheter 
  • Intern opplæring og mulighet til å søke vårt utdanningsprogram for fremtidige restaurantsjefer

title: 🌊 Bli bassengansvarlig for «Trygg i vann» – vi søker deg! 🏊‍♀️
description:
Har du overskudd, autoritet og et ekte engasjement for at barn skal lære å svømme? Sandefjord Svømmeklubb søker en voksen, tydelig person som skal ha det overordnede ansvaret på bassengkanten under våre svømmekurs – og som kan veilede og trygge våre unge instruktører (15–18 år) i jobben deres.

Hva vi ser etter

✔️ En moden, rolig og ansvarsbevisst voksenperson -- du kan f.eks. være pensjonist, ha fleksibel arbeidshverdag, jobbe skift, eller ha deltidsjobb, så lenge ettermiddagene passer

✔️ Tydelig og trygg i lederrollen -- du tør å sette grenser og gi klar beskjed, både til barn og til de unge instruktørene

✔️ Varm og tilstedeværende, men med god gjennomslagskraft

✔️ Praktisk anlagt, god til å ha oversikt over mange barn og voksne samtidig

✔️ Komfortabel med å være i vannet i en opplæringsperiode dersom du ikke har erfaring med dette fra før (den faste rollen er deretter hovedsakelig på land)

✔️ Behersker norsk godt, muntlig og skriftlig

Du trenger ikke svømmeinstruktør-bakgrunn fra før -- du læres opp av tidligere bassengansvarlige.

Arbeidsoppgaver

🔹 Ha det overordnede ansvaret på bassengkanten under svømmekurs

🔹 Støtte, veilede og gi tydelig beskjed til våre unge instruktører (fra 15 år) 🔹 Kommunisere med foresatte ved behov

🔹 Sørge for trygghet, struktur og god stemning -- både i og utenfor vannet 🔹 Bistå i vannet ved behov i egen opplæringsperiode; deretter hovedsakelig ansvar fra kanten

Vi tilbyr

🌟 Grundig opplæring og tett støtte fra klubben, inkludert overlapp med den som har hatt rollen tidligere

🌟 Et hyggelig og engasjert miljø rundt 16 lønnede instruktører

🌟 Konkurransedyktig timelønn (kr 260,- + feriepenger)

Om arbeidsgiveren:

SSandefjord Svømmeklubb ble stiftet i 1974 og har i over 50 år vært en aktiv idrettsforening med satsing på både konkurranse- og breddeidrett, i tillegg til svømmeopplæring for kommunens innbyggere.

I 2025 fikk 370 individer -- hovedsakelig barn -- svømmeopplæring gjennom <<Trygg i vann>>, som følger en svømmestige med syv nivåer for barn fra 5 år og oppover. Klubben tilbyr også egne kurs for voksne, og har i dag 16 lønnede instruktører knyttet til Trygg i vann.

Med stadig flere barn som ønsker svømmeopplæring, trenger vi nå flere trygge voksne som kan støtte teamet vårt på bassengkanten
