title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Robotics and Computer Vision
description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

ESS is now inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Fellow or Research Engineer in robotics and computer vision to work within the ASTRIND project to conduct research on, develop, and integrate an automated sample alignment system based on robotics and computer vision for the BEER instrument at ESS.

About the ASTRIND project:

Funded by the Röntgen-Ångström Cluster, this German-Swedish collaboration aims to enhance strain and texture measurements at ESS’s BEER diffractometer by transferring and extending robotic, vision, and simulation technologies developed at STRESS-SPEC (MLZ Munich). The project will improve alignment, motion planning, and sample exchange through multi-view camera tracking, integrated robot and hexapod control, and a BEER digital twin for calibration, collision-aware trajectory planning, and workflow validation. Additional tools for 3D-based measurement-point selection and in-situ digital image correlation will support advanced experiments. Cross-facility demonstrations between BEER and STRESS-SPEC will establish reproducible, standardized, and higher-throughput engineering diffraction workflows with improved data quality and industrial relevance.

About the role:

This position combines robotics, computer vision, software development, and moderate amount of experimental work with neutron diffraction technique to support the development and deployment of advanced sample alignment systems for the BEER instrument.

Your key responsibilities will include:

    Designing the system architecture (robot, cameras, auxiliary equipment) and propose hardware specifications, balancing performance requirements against the ASTRIND budget.
    Leading the integration of the sample robot, cameras, and auxiliary systems with the site-wide integrated control system (EPICS) and the neutron scattering control system (NICOS).
    Defining the data handling and user interfaces required for routine use of automated alignment during experiments.
    Planning and carrying out testing, commissioning, and validation of the system.
    Writing technical documentation

Depending on who we appoint into this position, you may also be:

    Conducting research and supervising master’s students on robotics and computer vision methods for automated sample alignment in neutron scattering applications.
    Publishing these research results in peer-reviewed journals and at conferences to strengthen the scientific output of the project.

This is a grant funded, fixed-term position for a period of three years. The role also requires the flexibility for occasional travel, including visits to project partners in Munich.

About you:

To succeed in this role, you need a strong background in robotics, mechatronics, automatic control, computer vision, or a very closely related field. This must be supported by either a PhD or an engineering degree together with relevant professional experience. You are motivated by the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced instrumentation, software integration, and experimental science within a large-scale international research facility.

You bring solid hands-on experience in robotics and computer vision, including system integration, motion control, sensor or camera systems, and software development for automated or semi-automated platforms. You are comfortable working across both hardware and software layers and enjoy turning complex technical requirements into reliable operational systems.

You have strong programming and software engineering skills, particularly in Python and C/C++, and are confident working in Linux environments, using version control systems such as Git, and developing within frameworks such as ROS. Experience with CAD software and mechanical system design is also expected.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

    Integration of robotic systems with scientific or industrial control systems.
    Machine vision, calibration, or multi-camera tracking systems.
    Motion planning, simulation, or digital twin environments.
    Experimental automation in research or large-scale infrastructure environments.
    EPICS, NICOS, neutron or synchrotron instrumentation, or similar scientific facilities.

For candidates applying at the postdoctoral level, experience of publishing research results and contributing to scientific projects is highly valued. Experience supervising students or mentoring junior colleagues would also be beneficial.

As a person, you are collaborative, proactive, and curious, with a strong interest in learning and developing new skills. You communicate clearly and work effectively with engineers, scientists, software developers, and technical staff from different disciplines and cultural backgrounds. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of an international team, and you have excellent written and spoken English skills.

To apply:

A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website.

This role might require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment process if needed.

For further information about the project please contact Gergely Németh, mailto:gergely.nemeth@ess.eu or Karin Rathsman, mailto:karin.rathsman@ess.eu.

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on mailto:erusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at mailto:marc.kickulies@ess.eu

title: Client Operations Specialist
description:
Location: Norrköping, Sweden (on-site with some remote flexibility)

About OrbitMI and the role

OrbitMI provides maritime software and services that help shipping companies improve operational performance, regulatory compliance, fuel efficiency, and decision-making.

OrbitMI is looking for a Client Operations Specialist to join our growing team in Norrköping, working closely with the Gale Force team and supporting the delivery of our managed maritime services.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role at the centre of our daily operations. You will support vessels, operators, and shipowners using the Orbit Platform and our managed services, while acting as an important link between customers, maritime specialists, and our product and development teams.

What you will do

As a Client Operations Specialist, you will:

    Provide day-to-day support to vessels, operators, and shipowners using the Orbit Platform and our managed services.
    Support customers on maritime regulatory topics, including EU ETS, FuelEU Maritime, and CII.
    Work as part of Client Operations, sharing knowledge, responsibilities, and workload across the team.
    Act as a key link between customers and internal product and development teams by identifying issues, clarifying requirements, and following up on solutions.
    Investigate and reproduce technical issues, document findings clearly, and contribute to practical fixes and service improvements where appropriate.
    Help improve working methods, customer support processes, and the continued development of our managed maritime services.



What we are looking for

You likely have:

    A maritime background, such as seagoing experience, shipping operations, maritime compliance, or similar industry exposure.
    Working knowledge of EU ETS, FuelEU Maritime, and CII, or a strong ability and interest in developing this expertise quickly.
    Confidence working directly with vessels, operators, and shipowners, as well as with internal operational and technical teams.
    Strong communication skills and the ability to translate operational questions into clear requirements and practical actions.
    Good technical aptitude, curiosity, and a structured approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving.
    The ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international environment.
    Based in, or willing to relocate to, Norrköping.
    Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in Sweden.
    Please note that we are unable to provide visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have

    Experience in a customer-facing, client operations, or managed services role.
    Familiarity with maritime software platforms, noon reporting, emissions reporting, or fleet performance tools.
    Basic scripting, data analysis, or coding experience, such as Python or SQL. This is an advantage, not a requirement.

  

What we offer

    A central role in a growing international maritime technology company.
    The opportunity to combine maritime expertise, customer interaction, and technology in practical daily operations.
    Close collaboration with experienced colleagues from OrbitMI and Gale Force.
    The opportunity to influence how our Client Operations and managed services continue to develop.
    A supportive working environment with room to learn, take responsibility, and grow.
    A role that contributes to bringing OrbitMI and Gale Force together as one organisation.

  

Interested in joining us?

We would be pleased to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV. We look forward to learning more about your experience and interest in the role.

title: Assistant Workplace lead
description:
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions is a leading global provider of integrated facilities and corporate real estate management. We are recruiting for an Assistant Workplace Lead to join our team in Stockholm. This is a great opportunity for an experienced and enthusiastic candidate to join a global account team.

As Assistant Workplace Lead you will deputize to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing strategic support and operational leadership across campus. This role drives operational excellence, leads improvement projects, and supports governance and reporting activities to ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction.

Acting as a trusted partner to the Workplace Operations Lead, this role ensures continuity of leadership, drives operational initiatives, and maintains strong relationships with stakeholders and service partners. The Assistant Lead plays a critical role in translating strategic vision into operational execution, supporting the team to deliver consistent, efficient, and customer-focused facilities services across all sites within the geographical scope.

What You'll Do:

Client relationship and stakeholder engagement


    Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across campus and act a senior point of contact

    Represent CBRE interests and teams while aligning with the client's needs and expectations

    Support in client engagement activities and service review meetings with senior stakeholders

    Communicate operational updates, changes, and improvements to stakeholders in both English and Swedish

    Foster collaborative relationships with service providers and suppliers


Finance, governance and reporting


    Be well-versed in CBRE's contractual commitments, including financial, commercial and performance models and ensure operational compliance with contractual obligations

    Collate, prepare and analyse performance and governance reports to enable client sign off

    Collaborate with Workplace operations- lead, managers and Finance teams to prepare accurate forecasts, financial performance reviews and budget drafts

    Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to help the team and client to better understand the operational output

    Prepare analysis and presentations on operational performance, key performance indicators, customer satisfaction and trends and make recommendations for improvements and service adjustments


Leadership and team support


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in team leadership and management

    Provide guidance, coaching, and support to Workplace Operations Managers

    Foster a culture focused on service excellence, proactiveness and continuous improvement

    Support performance management activities, succession planning and team development initiatives

    Drive the one team and service first mindset across campus alongside the client

    Review and sign off on annual leave and other resource planning activities


Operational leadership and site management


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in overseeing facilities operations and service delivery

    Good understanding of CBRE's contractual commitments, including statement of work, matrix of responsibility and service level agreements in order to translate these into effective deliverables for the teams in collaboration with the Workplace operations lead

    Act as deputy to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing leadership continuity in their absence

    Monitor service delivery performance and identify areas requiring attention or improvement and coordinate with Workplace operations managers to resolve challenges and implement improvements

    Working closely with QHSE- and operational teams to ensure sites are fully compliant with the client's and CBRE's QHSE standards

    Ensure health and safety policies and observations are logged to minimize risk exposure and enable a safe workplace environment

    Review and sign off all campus applicable risk assessments together with the Workplace Operations Manager


Improvement projects and strategic initiatives


    Lead and manage improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and service quality

    Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions

    Drive continuous improvement initiatives across campus operations

    Be an active participant in our vendor care program, working closely with strategically important service partners across the contract

    Support implementation of transformational change programs, including the Evolve program

    Analyse operational data and trends to inform strategic decision-making

    Program manage key projects, acting as a conduit between the client and CBRE's operational and project teams


Working hours and location

This position is based at the client's premises in Kista, Stockholm. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.

title: Avelsrådgivare och dossäljare Värmland
description:
Växa är ett ledande kunskapsföretag för lantbrukare med mjölk-, köttproduktion och växtodling. Genom den rådgivning och service vi säljer bidrar vi med ökad konkurrenskraft för svenskt lantbruk. Vår omsättning är drygt 560 miljoner kronor och vi har cirka 500 medarbetare fördelade på 27 driftsplatser över hela landet. Hållbarhet är centralt för oss, och våra kunder och Växa står för klimatsmart produktion och god djurhälsa.

Hos Växa får du utveckling - bra förmåner och engagerade kollegor. Tillsammans gör vi skillnad för våra kunder och medlemmar, och det märks!

About the Workplace

Växa is a leading knowledge-based company serving farmers within dairy, meat production, and crop cultivation. Through the advisory services and support we provide, we contribute to strengthening the competitiveness of Swedish agriculture. Our annual turnover exceeds SEK 560 million, and we employ approximately 500 people across 27 operational locations throughout the country. Sustainability is central to our mission, and together with our customers, Växa promotes climate‑smart production and high standards of animal health.

At Växa, you will find opportunities for development, attractive benefits, and dedicated colleagues. Together, we make a meaningful difference for our customers and members — and it truly shows.

1 plats(er).


Avelsrådgivare och dossäljare Kil, Värmland

Vill du vara med att utveckla framtidens mjölkkor i Sverige? Gillar du att skapa relationer med mjölk- och köttproducenter? Hos oss har du chansen att hitta ett roligt och utvecklande arbete! Vi söker en person som tycker om och vill arbeta med avel, kor, rådgivning, service och sälj. Är det du? Sök redan idag!

Tjänsten består av två delar, dels avelsrådgivning till våra befintliga och nya kunder, dels dossäljare. Som avelsrådgivare arbetar du tillsammans med kunderna med avelsstrategi och avelsplanering utifrån gårdens målsättningar.  Dossäljare innebär att du hanterar och tar in beställningar av doser som du levererar till gård var åttonde vecka då du även fyller på kväve i djurägarkärlen.

Du har ett lokalt team att luta dig mot men vi förväntar oss att du tar egna initiativ, har ett sinne för ordning och reda och kan arbeta självständigt.

Vi säljer VikingGenetics avelsmaterial och rådgivning till våra kunder. Blir du en av oss kommer du att vara en del i att utveckla framtidens hållbara kor och arbeta för att utveckla svensk animalieproduktion i nära samarbete med lantbrukare och våra andra rådgivare.

Vi söker dig som  

    Är Lantmästare, Agronom, Agrotekniker eller har skaffat erfarenhet av nötkreatur på annat sätt.
    Intresse för sälj och problemlösning på gård.
    Har god kommunikationsförmåga
    Har goda kunskaper i svenska, tal och skrift
    Har B-körkort och gillar att köra bil

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga drivkraft och söker personer med stort engagemang och förmåga att möta människor. Som person är du öppen och lyhörd med tydligt affärs-, kund- och lösningsfokus. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och tycker om att samarbeta i team.

Det är ett extra plus om du har

    Praktisk erfarenhet från lantbruk/djurproduktion
    Intresse och kunskap om avel

Omfattning och placeringsort

Heltid med placering på Växas driftsplats i Kil

Vi erbjuder
En spännande tjänst. Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Möjlighet att arbeta i ett dynamiskt team där vi tillsammans driver utvecklingen framåt.

    Ett flexibelt arbetsliv
    Kompetenta och engagerade kollegor
    Individuellt anpassad kompetensutveckling
    Sjukvårdsförsäkring
    Friskvårdsbidrag

För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta
Regionchef avel Sara Wiklert Petersson 010 - 4710702

title: Corporate Legal Counsel
description:
The opportunity

We're currently looking for a Corporate Legal Counsel to join our Corporate Legal team. In this role, you will provide strategic legal advice and support across a broad range of corporate, governance, securities regulation, capital markets, finance, and transaction-related matters. You will play a key role in supporting Polestar's listed parent company and global corporate structure, helping ensure compliance with regulatory requirements while enabling the business to achieve its strategic objectives.

As part of the Legal function, you will work closely with executive management, the Board of Directors, and stakeholders across Finance, Treasury, Accounting, Sustainability, Investor Relations, and Corporate Communications. You will advise on governance matters, corporate transactions, capital markets activities, public company compliance, and other strategic initiatives that support Polestar's continued growth and transformation.

This position is located in HQ, Gothenburg, Sweden. We believe in a hybrid model when it comes to remote and onsite work, knowing that both in-person collaboration and individual focus time are important for success.

The responsibilities

In this role, you'll be a trusted business partner, providing practical legal advice to support strategic and operational decision-making across Polestar, while helping to maintain strong corporate governance and regulatory compliance.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Lead and support legal work relating to capital markets transactions, including debt and equity financings and other strategic corporate finance initiatives.

    

Advise on corporate governance matters relating to Polestar's listed parent company and global subsidiaries.

    

Support compliance with securities regulations, SEC requirements, and NASDAQ listing rules.

    

Advise on corporate policies, procedures, governance best practices, and compliance with market abuse and insider trading regulations.

    

Manage and coordinate external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring effective delivery and budget oversight.

    

Partner with senior stakeholders across the business to provide pragmatic legal advice that balances risk management with commercial objective.

The ideal candidate

To succeed in this role, you'll need excellent legal judgment, strong business acumen, and the ability to navigate complex legal matters in a fast-paced international environment. You combine technical legal expertise with a practical, solution-oriented mindset and are comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization. You thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve, and you enjoy working on a diverse range of high-impact corporate and strategic matters.

In addition, you'll need the following qualifications:

    

Master degree in Law (LLM), preferably from relevant Swedish, U.S., or other European university.

    

Extensive relevant experience (approximately 7+ years), including experience from a leading law firm and in-house legal roles within a global publicly listed company.

    

Strong experience in securities regulation, disclosure requirements, capital markets transactions, corporate finance, M&A, and general corporate matters.

    

Knowledge of Swedish, U.K. and/or U.S. corporate law.

    

Proven experience advising on public company compliance, corporate governance, and stock exchange regulations.

    

Experience of supporting a Board and/or Committee, preparing Board and Committee materials, including advising on governance processes and regulatory requirements.

    

Experience managing external legal counsel and coordinating support across multiple jurisdictions.

    

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Beneficial, but not required:

    

Experience with SEC, NASDAQ and Sarbanes-Oxley rules and compliance.

    

Familiarity with Loan Market Association documentation.

    

Experience managing complex litigation matters, particularly in the U.S.

    

Familiarity with IFRS accounting and audit practices.

    

Familiarity with U.S. and European audit practices

    

Experience with equity incentive plans.

    

Additional European languages and/or Mandarin proficiency

Polestar is an international company with colleagues representing diverse backgrounds and perspectives. English is our primary language for written and spoken communication. As we continue to grow globally, change is constant, but so is progress. Expect an accelerating, exciting environment where your expertise will have visible impact across the organization.

The process

If the above matches your ambitions, be sure to apply. We apply a continuous selection process and the job ad will be open until the position is filled.

title: Logistikchef
description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Rollen som logistikchef hos oss innebär ett helhetsansvar för logistikflödet – från planering till leverans – med fokus på leveransprecision, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt – nära verksamheten, affären och våra samarbetspartners. Du blir en del av fabrikens ledningsgrupp och rapporterar direkt till Plant Manager. Du har också en Planeringschef underställd Logistikchef som ansvarar för ca 17 pers. På hela logistik arbetar det ca 130 pers inkl konsulter Verksamheten är en högvolymsfabrik som levererar över 550 000 artiklar per vecka till ett flertal stora kunder. Vi söker en ledare som vill vara med på vår utvecklings- och förändringsresa. Rollen är på 100 % och utgår från vår fabrik i Färgelanda.

    Tydlig och kommunikativ ledare: Du är en trygg chef som sätter klara ramar och arbetsbeskrivningar, samtidigt som du coachar ditt team till att tänka nytt och fatta egna beslut.
    Prestigelös och handlingskraftig: Du är absolut "hands on" när det krävs, är lyhörd för organisationen men har samtidigt modet att stå fast vid fattade beslut.
    Analytisk och datadriven: Du fattar beslut baserat på fakta och data. Du har lätt för att göra analyser som räddar dagen här och nu, men också säkrar flödet för framtiden.
    Resultatorienterad: Du arbetar strukturerat mot uppsatta mål och följer upp verksamheten genom nyckeltal.

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Artifex med Randstad. Tjänsten kan komma att bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag, ansök därför så snart som möjligt. För information kontakta: Liza Dahlin, rekryteringskonsult e-mail: liza.dahlin@randstad.se



Ansvarsområden

    Resultat- och leveransansvar: Säkerställa hög leveransprecision, kundnöjdhet samt uppföljning av relevanta KPI:er kopplade till logistik och flöde.
    Logistikstyrning: Ansvara för lagerstyrning, kapacitetsplanering samt utveckling av effektiva material- och informationsflöden.
    Leverantörssamverkan: Säkerställa effektiva samarbeten med leverantörer och interna funktioner för att optimera flöden och tillgänglighet.
    Förbättringsarbete: Driva och implementera förbättringsinitiativ enligt våra principer.
    Hälsa och säkerhet: Driva och prioritera arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsfrågor som en naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten.




Kvalifikationer

    Erfarenhet: Gedigen och stor erfarenhet inom logistik samt ett dokumenterat framgångsrikt ledarskap.
    Branschbakgrund: Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin (Automotive) och förståelse för dess komplexa processer är starkt meriterande. Alternativt har du bakgrund från någon större logistikaktör samt arbetat med logistikflödet kopplat till produktion.
    System och IT: God vana av SAP samt mycket starka kunskaper i Excel.
    Språk: Då vi arbetar på en internationell marknad krävs mycket goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
    Geografiskt fokus: Vi ser gärna att du bor i exempelvis Trollhättan, Uddevalla eller Stenungsund med omnejd då det passar bäst för pendling.




Om företaget



Artifex Systems AB

Artifex Systems AB is a trusted partner in the European automotive supply chain, delivering high-quality components and systems to leading premium vehicle manufacturers. With three strategically located sites in Sweden—Låssby (Gothenburg), Skara, and Färgelanda—we operate as a unified and agile business unit, capable of managing the entire journey from concept design to finished products.
Our strength lies in combining engineering expertise with advanced manufacturing to provide complete, reliable solutions tailored to customer needs. Driven by a culture of continuous improvement, we are committed to sustainable innovation that balances performance with responsibility. By fostering long-term partnerships with global automotive brands, Artifex Systems AB positions itself as a future-ready supplier, dedicated to shaping the next generation of mobility.
Vision: Provide tailor-made interior and exterior solutions, driven by passion, precision and the power of our people. Driving Innovation with Purpose.
Mission: Create tailor-made interior and exterior solutions for the global automotive industry premium segment. With a strong focus on design, precision, and material quality, we deliver components that enhance both the experience and value of every vehicle.

title: Head of Business Development - Mobile Power Solutions
description:
What you will do

As Head of Business Development - Mobile Power Solutions, you will lead the commercial development agenda across our global Sales and Service Market organization.



Our business provides mobile power solutions across both combustion engine and electrified applications, serving customers in segments such as mining, agriculture, material handling, forestry, special vehicles, on-road and construction. In this role, you will take a holistic view of the customer and business lifecycle, from winning new business and supporting market introduction to creating long-term value from the installed base.



You will translate market trends, customer insights, demand development and competitive intelligence into clear commercial priorities and growth opportunities. This includes developing commercial plans across markets and segments, identifying new applications, partnerships and aftermarket opportunities, and ensuring that the voice of the market is represented in our product and service development.



A key part of your responsibility will be to understand how changing technologies and customer needs, including the transition from combustion engines to electrified solutions, impact our business. You will establish relevant commercial KPIs, develop market outlooks and ensure that analysis leads to concrete actions that strengthen sales, profitability and customer value.



You will also facilitate alignment between global and regional organizations, challenging us with a strong outside-in perspective on what we need to do to win – today and throughout the lifecycle of our products.



Your future team

You will be part of the Global Sales & Service Market organization and work across a broad international network of commercial, product and market functions.



The role involves close collaboration with regional organizations and colleagues across Sales, Service Market, Product Management and other key functions. You will operate across diverse customer segments, markets and technologies, creating alignment around commercial priorities and long-term growth opportunities.



You will join an environment characterized by collaboration, high ambitions and a shared focus on creating customer value and profitable growth.



Who are you?

You are a strategic and commercially driven leader who combines a strong market perspective with analytical capability and a clear focus on execution. You are equally comfortable developing long-term direction, working with detailed business analysis and turning insights into action.



We believe you have:

    Proven experience in business development, commercial strategy, sales, service market or market development, preferably in a global B2B environment

title: Database Engineer
description:
PostgreSQL Database Engineer with Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration experience – this opportunity is for you. Join a large-scale, business-critical database migration where you will take a key hands-on role in moving database services from Oracle to PostgreSQL. You will combine deep technical expertise with ownership and close collaboration with development teams in a large international technology environment.

Job description

As a Database Engineer, you will play a central role in the end-to-end migration of database services from Oracle to PostgreSQL. The assignment is highly technical and hands-on, while giving you the opportunity to take technical ownership and act as an important link between development teams and the database environment.

Working closely with developers and database specialists, you will translate application requirements into reliable and practical PostgreSQL solutions. You will review and validate database schemas, configurations and application changes to ensure accuracy, compatibility and performance throughout the migration.

A key objective is to ensure a smooth transition with minimal disruption to business-critical services. The applications do not contain PL/SQL code, meaning no PL/SQL conversion is required as part of the assignment.

Key responsibilities

    Lead and provide hands-on technical support throughout the Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration
    Work closely with development teams and database specialists throughout the migration journey
    Translate application requirements into practical and reliable PostgreSQL solutions
    Review and validate database schemas, configurations and application code changes
    Ensure database performance, compatibility and accuracy throughout the migration
    Troubleshoot PostgreSQL-related issues and contribute to technical decision-making
    Work with Liquibase for database schema versioning and migration
    Contribute to a migration approach that minimizes downtime and disruption to business-critical services
    Document technical findings, learnings and best practices for future database migrations

We are looking for someone who

    Has extensive professional experience as a PostgreSQL DBA, Database Engineer or PostgreSQL Developer
    Has deep technical knowledge of PostgreSQL and is comfortable working hands-on with databases
    Has previous experience with Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration projects
    Has a good understanding of Oracle databases and Oracle-to-PostgreSQL datatype mappings
    Has experience working with database schemas, SQL, configurations and database performance
    Has experience with or a good understanding of Liquibase and database schema versioning
    Is comfortable working independently within an established migration framework
    Is proactive, structured and able to take technical ownership of complex migration activities
    Has strong communication and collaboration skills and enjoys working closely with software development teams
    Is fluent in English, both spoken and written, as this is the primary working language

Nice to have

It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:

    Java applications connected to PostgreSQL
    Distributed systems and event-driven architectures
    Kafka and/or Solace
    Migrating high-traffic or business-critical services with minimal downtime
    AI-assisted development workflows and tools such as Cursor, Claude or similar agent-based solutions

Great emphasis will be placed on your ability to combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative mindset. We believe you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, taking initiative and helping development teams move forward throughout the migration.

About the client

Our client is a large international company within the gaming and digital entertainment industry, operating high-traffic digital services across multiple markets. Technology is at the core of the organization, with a strong focus on developing and modernizing scalable, reliable and business-critical platforms.

In this assignment, you will become part of a technically complex environment where database reliability, performance and availability are essential to the business.

Due to the confidential nature of the recruitment process, further information about the company will be shared at a later stage.

About the employment

This is a 12-month consulting assignment, where you will be employed by Friday and work as a consultant for our client.

Other information

    Scope: Full-time
    Start: As soon as possible, with consideration to any notice period
    Location: Central Stockholm
    Contact: Axel Stubbing, axel.stubbing@friday.se

About Friday

At Friday, we are passionate about helping tech talent find opportunities where they can grow, develop and look forward to going to work. By understanding what motivates you, we match you with companies and assignments that fit both your skills and ambitions.

We value potential and ambition and actively work towards an unbiased recruitment process where everyone is given the same opportunity to succeed.

title: Business Solution Architect, Lund
description:

title: Service Delivery Manager
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

H&M is continuing to shape the future of digital commerce by creating stable, connected, and customer-focused experiences across our global digital landscape. Within Digital Transaction, we are strengthening our end-to-end technical coordination across key customer journeys such as login, cart, checkout, payment, order management, and returns.

We are now looking for a Service Delivery Manager to help safeguard end-to-end technical coherence, integration integrity, and operational readiness across the Digital Transaction area. This role supports the Area Tech Manager by ensuring that independently accountable product teams collectively deliver a stable, resilient, and customer-safe end-to-end solution.

This is not a governance layer. It is a coordinating and enabling role focused on transparency, early risk visibility, and technical alignment across teams, products, platforms, and external vendor integrations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Maintain a holistic end-to-end technical view across the Digital Transaction customer journey.
    Continuously update and communicate the E2E integration landscape across products and components.
    Identify cross-component risks, integration breakpoints, and architectural drift before they impact customers.
    Safeguard critical customer journeys, including login, cart, checkout, payment, order management, and returns.
    Ensure integration sequencing, dependency transparency, and API contract discipline across teams and vendors.
    Support coordinated E2E go-live readiness for multi-component releases.
    Validate E2E test readiness, deployment coordination, and operational preparedness across product areas.
    Ensure observability, traceability, resilience, and error handling consistency across the full customer journey.
    Surface technical debt and structural misalignment that may impact customer-facing stability.
    Support incident analysis by helping teams treat issues as end-to-end journey concerns rather than isolated product failures.
    Provide the Area Tech Manager with clear E2E risk visibility, early escalation points, and proactive recommendations.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will work closely with the Area Tech Manager, Solution Architects, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Operations, Program Managers, and multiple product teams across the Digital Transaction area.

You will play an important role in connecting technical perspectives across teams and making sure that dependencies, risks, and customer impact are visible early. You will support alignment across independently accountable teams without taking over their mandate or decision authority.

We are looking for someone who enjoys collaboration, complexity, and problem-solving across teams. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment where technical coordination, clear communication, and proactive risk management are key to delivering stable customer experiences.

WHO YOU ARE

    You have solid experience working in complex digital, ecommerce, platform, or transaction-heavy technology environments.
    You understand end-to-end customer journeys and how technical dependencies across systems can impact customer experience.
    You have experience coordinating technical delivery, integration readiness, or operational readiness across multiple teams.
    You have strong knowledge of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, and cloud-based architectures.
    You understand observability, monitoring, tracing, error handling, resilience, and production stability.
    You are experienced in identifying cross-team dependencies, integration risks, and technical gaps.
    You can translate complex technical risks into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
    You are comfortable working with Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, Product Managers, Operations, and Program Managers.
    You have strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer attractive benefits, flexible ways of working, and extensive opportunities for professional growth across our global organization.

You'll work on business-critical enterprise platforms, collaborate with talented global engineering teams, and help shape the future of supply chain technology using modern cloud, integration, and AI-driven engineering practices.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

title: Senior Lecturer in horticultural genomics and breeding
description:
Faculty of Landscape Architecture, Horticulture and Crop Production Science

The Department of Plant Breeding

Read the complete ad here: Jobs and vacancies | slu.se



Subject area

The subject of the position is horticulture, with a focus on plant genetics and genomics. The emphasis is on key traits in horticultural crops, such as resistance to diseases and pests, product quality, and climate adaptation. The subject is of central importance to sustainable horticultural production systems in the Nordic region.

Duties

The work is expected to combine methods such as quantitative genetics, genotyping, genetic markers and phenotyping, sequencing and -omics technology to generate knowledge on key resistance, quality and adaptation traits that can be translated into breeding strategies for sustainable horticultural production in the Nordic region. The senior lecturer shall, within the subject of the position,

    establish and develop internationally competitive research that complements and strengthens the department's ongoing research and is in line with the faculty's and the university's strategic goals
    apply for external research funds in competition
    plan, lead and implement research projects
    develop synergies with other relevant research at the department
    publish scientific articles
    develop, lead and conduct teaching at undergraduate, advanced and doctoral levels
    supervise students at all levels in the educational cycle
    develop and maintain national and international networks with researchers, industry, businesses and authorities
    communicate about research and research results
    be able to teach in Swedish or another Scandinavian language

The department has a parallel-language working environment. The senior lecturer will be able to carry out most academic duties in English. However, since Swedish is the university’s official working language, the candidate is expected to achieve a functional level of Swedish within four years of appointment. The department undertakes to provide support to help the candidate reach this goal.

Qualifications

The applicant must, within the subject of the position,

    have completed a doctoral degree in biology, horticulture, plant breeding or genetics or have equivalent scientific competence
    be scientifically skilled and have experience in basic and applied research, and plant breeding or pre-breeding
    have demonstrated the ability to obtain external research grants
    have demonstrated pedagogical skills in teaching at the undergraduate and graduate levels, including supervision of students
    have experience in supervising doctoral students
    have completed higher education teaching training or otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge
    have good knowledge of English

Assessment criteria

The assessment criteria for employment shall primarily be the degree of such skill as is a requirement for eligibility for employment.

When assessing scientific skill within the subject of employment, the following shall be taken into account:

    completed research efforts and ongoing research
    ability to independently initiate and conduct outstanding and innovative research
    external research funding received in competition

When assessing pedagogical skill within the subject of employment, the following shall be taken into account:

    planning, implementation, examination and evaluation of own teaching
    supervision and examination at all levels in the educational cycle
    ability to integrate research and a scientific approach into pedagogical work
    pedagogical vision

Furthermore, skills in

    developing and leading operations and personnel within the academy/university
    communicating and collaborating
    collaborating with external stakeholders and the surrounding community
    informing/communicating about research and development work

Expertise in quantitative genetics, modern genomic tools, the integration of multi-omics data, and the evaluation of traits in horticultural crops intended for food production within Nordic cultivation systems is considered a particular merit. A network of contacts with stakeholders in the Swedish and/or Nordic horticultural sector is also considered a particular merit.

The assessment of pedagogical skills shall be given equal care as the assessment of scientific skills.

The position is offered to those who, after a qualitative overall assessment, are deemed to have the best conditions to carry out and develop current work tasks and contribute to a positive development of the business.

Working at SLU

At SLU, you become part of a vibrant research environment that is based on active https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/working-at-slu/. As an employee at SLU, you have access to a number of benefits (including Swedish family healthcare, parental leave and generous paid leave policies). Read more about benefits at SLU https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/benefits_at_SLU/. SLU is often https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/about-the-university/university-ranking/ in the various university rankings that are made around the world and is ranked as one of Sweden's https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/about-the-university/employer-ranking/.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
Location: Stockholm & Boden

Reporting to: Project Delivery Leadership

Function: Project Delivery

We are building one of the world’s most advanced greenfield steel plants; a fully integrated, low-carbon facility designed from the ground up for sustainability, efficiency, and future scalability. We are looking for an exceptional Head of Engineering to lead the engineering function within our Project Delivery team.

In this critical leadership role, you will own the end-to-end engineering delivery for the current Stegra Boden greenfield steel mill project and lay the foundation for replicating and scaling similar projects globally. You will build and lead a high-performing, multi-disciplinary engineering organisation while ensuring world-class standards in safety, quality, cost, and schedule in a complex industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

    Build, lead, and develop a strong in-house engineering organisation covering all major disciplines (process, mechanical, electrical, civil/structural, automation, environmental, etc.).
    Define and drive the overall engineering strategy, technical standards, design philosophies, and ways of working for the project and future global rollouts.
    Ensure engineering deliverables meet the highest requirements for safety, quality, cost control, and schedule across all project phases (FEED, detailed design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and start-up).
    Oversee coordination and integration of engineering partners, EPC contractors, technology providers, and equipment suppliers.
    Lead field engineering, construction technical support, and quality assurance activities on site, with a strong focus on resolving technical issues in real time.
    Establish robust engineering governance, change management processes, document control, and lessons-learned systems.
    Manage the engineering budget, drive value engineering, and continuously improve engineering performance and productivity.
    Work seamlessly with Construction, Procurement, Commissioning, Operations, HS&E, and other functions to deliver truly integrated project execution.
    Champion a strong safety culture, embedding best practices in design for operational safety.

As a fast-growing company with minimal silos, you will be expected to contribute flexibly beyond core engineering tasks when needed.

What You will Bring

You are a collaborative, curious, and decisive leader who thrives in complex, high-stakes environments. You challenge conventional thinking constructively, build trust across teams, and are passionate about delivering transformative industrial projects.

We understand that not all candidates will fulfill all the requirements listed below. However, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:

Essential qualifications and experience:

    10–15+ years of progressive experience in engineering leadership on large-scale capital projects, preferably in steel, metals, mining, oil & gas, chemicals, or other heavy/process industries.
    Direct experience on greenfield industrial projects (ideally steel plants, DRI/HBI facilities, or similar first-of-a-kind plants) from detailed design through construction and commissioning.
    Proven track record of successfully building and developing high-performing, multi-disciplinary engineering teams (50+ people, including matrix and external resources).
    Strong hands-on understanding of full project execution - from conceptual/FEED engineering to field realities, constructability, and start-up.
    Demonstrated success in managing complex interfaces with EPC contractors, technology licensors, and major equipment suppliers.
    Deep knowledge of relevant engineering standards, quality systems, risk management, and change control in heavy industry.
    Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels in a multicultural, international setting.
    A genuine and visible commitment to safety leadership and the ability to embed a strong safety culture across engineering and construction teams.
    University degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Process, Civil, or another relevant engineering discipline (Master’s or Chartered/Professional Engineer status is a plus).

Highly advantageous:

    Experience with hydrogen and steel technologies (DRI, hydrogen reduction, EAF, Hot & Cold Rolling will be beneficial).
    Previous exposure to modular construction, digital twins, advanced automation, or BIM/3D model-based project delivery.
    International project experience and comfort working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial scale-up environment.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the engineering backbone of a landmark green steel project and build capabilities that will support replication. If you are an experienced engineering leader ready to take full ownership in a high-visibility, purpose-driven project, we would love to hear from you.

title: Financial Controller
description:
We believe great companies are built by people who are driven to solve difficult problems.

At Nextory, we're building the future of reading and listening. It's an ambitious goal that demands exceptional execution, relentless curiosity, and a willingness to challenge convention. We set a high bar for ourselves because we believe that's what it takes to create products people love.

If you're motivated by impact, energized by ambitious teammates, and excited by the opportunity to build something category-defining, you'll feel at home here.

Let us tell you about the role 📖

This is a broad role that sits close to both the numbers and the business. You will play a key role in our monthly close, follow up costs against budget, and work across our international entities, and at the same time you'll be one of the people rethinking how all of it gets done.

You'll get a lot of ownership from the start, and plenty of room to run with your own ideas. If you spot something that could be automated, streamlined or built better - bring it up, and then go build it. That's the fun part: the better you are at building, the more of this role becomes analysis.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    

Driving improvement projects through automation and AI

    

Contributing to larger projects, including new systems and ways of working

    

Handling the monthly close for our parent company and subsidiaries

    

Reconciling costs, explaining deviations and identifying accruals

    

Coordinating subsidiary close activities with external accounting partners

    

Producing ad-hoc analyses and decision support for management

    

Managing VAT reporting and external provider approvals across markets

    

Contributing to budgeting and planning

    

Supporting colleagues with data, documentation and NetSuite insights

Your story so far 👀

We believe you're an accountant or controller who hates doing the same thing twice. You know your way around spreadsheets and debit-credit, but you're also always looking for smarter ways to work, whether through automation, AI, agents, or a bit of code. Most of all, you're curious. You like trying new things, taking initiative, and experimenting, even when not everything works out because around here, that’s how we learn.

Furthermore, we believe you have:

    

A degree in accounting, finance, business administration or similar

    

3+ years of experience in controlling and/or accounting, including hands-on work with month-end close

    

A solid understanding of accounting principles and how the numbers are built, international or group experience is a plus

    

Strong Excel skills, and experience with a modern ERP (NetSuite experience is a big plus)

    

Fluency in Swedish and English, written and spoken

We’d be especially happy to see:

    

That you already use AI tools in your everyday work, and have found ways to make them genuinely useful

    

Some experience of getting data out of systems yourself, rather than waiting for someone else to build the report

    

That you've tried your hand at automating something, whether that's a smart Excel solution, a simple script, or a tool you found and made work

    

Curiosity about how AI and agents could take over parts of the manual work in Finance

    

Experience improving reporting or dashboards

You don't need to tick every box. If you know your way around the numbers and have a real builder's instinct, we want to talk to you.

The Nextory way of working 🏠

At Nextory, we believe a strong and inclusive culture is key to our success and that culture flourishes when we meet and collaborate in person as much as possible. That’s why we spend the majority of the working time at our beautiful office!

We are based in Stockholm, Sweden, with offices in Paris and Bangalore. Our hybrid work policy includes four days in the office and Wednesdays as a work-from-home day.

Your next story starts here 💫

We look forward to your application 💫. Applications are reviewed continuously, if you have any questions about the role, please contact erika.thorslund@nextory.com

Please note that we do not offer relocation and that a six-month probationary period applies.

The Role

In this role, you are responsible for developing, verifying, and quality-assuring the electronics and embedded software in Sunmedic's medical devices, with a particular focus on the VivereX™ NPWT system. You work close to the business and play a key role in ensuring reliable product performance, high quality, and compliance with medical device standards and regulations. The work is carried out in close collaboration with several functions within the organization, including production, quality, regulatory affairs, and maintenance.

The role involves both development work and hands-on engagement in testing, troubleshooting, and quality control, with significant scope to influence technical solutions, design choices, and ways of working in order to deliver safe and quality-assured products.

Responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and improve electronics designs (hardware) and embedded software/firmware for medical devices

- Design, perform, and document verification and validation testing of electronics and embedded systems

- Be responsible for quality control of electronic components and finished products, including incoming inspection, functional testing, and non-conformance management

- Ensure that electronics development and testing are carried out in accordance with medical device requirements and standards (e.g. ISO 13485, IEC 60601, IEC 62304).

- Establish and maintain technical documentation, traceability, and design history (DHF/risk analysis)

- Provide technical support in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and optimization of electronics-related processes in production

- Participate in supplier evaluation and quality follow-up of electronic components

- Collaborate closely with production, quality, maintenance, and technical specialists, as well as clinical and regulatory functions

Qualifications and Personal Attributes

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in electronics, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent

- Experience in electronics development and embedded systems, e.g. microcontroller-based design, firmware development (C/C++), sensors, and circuit design

- Experience in quality control, testing, and verification of electronic products, preferably within medical technology or another regulated industry

- Knowledge of medical device standards and regulations (e.g. ISO 13485, IEC 60601, IEC 62304, MDR) is highly meritorious

- Accustomed to combining analytical work with hands-on problem solving and troubleshooting

- Works in a structured, meticulous, and documentation-conscious manner with a strong focus on quality and continuous improvement

- Communicative and comfortable collaborating across organizational boundaries

- Ability to work in a regulated environment with a focus on quality, safety, and traceability

What the Role Offers

At Sunmedic, you will be a driving force in the development of advanced electronic medical devices, where technology, embedded systems, and continuous improvement are at the core. We work with world-leading product solutions for wound care and infection prevention technology, including the VivereX™ NPWT system and advanced dressings. The organization is characterized by commitment, accountability, and a strong desire to grow within medical technology.

About Sunmedic

Sunmedic is a trusted Swedish manufacturer of medical devices focused on advanced wound care solutions. Our product range includes the VivereX™ NPWT system and antimicrobial technologies, as well as dressings and foams that support faster healing and safer patient outcomes. We combine research-driven development with advanced technology to deliver effective tools for healthcare professionals. Sunmedic provides full support, from clinical guidance to after-market support, and partners worldwide to deliver the right solutions where they are needed.

title: Partner Manager
description:

We are seeking a Partner Manager to join our growing global connected services team in Stockholm, Sweden. In this role, you will act as the central point of contact for managing key partner relationships, monitoring performance, and ensuring governance. You will balance strategic oversight with hands-on management to drive operational excellence, contract alignment, and partner satisfaction.

The role also includes shaping partner management strategies, optimizing costs, and proactively identifying and mitigating operational risks.

You will play a critical role in fostering strong partner collaboration, ensuring strict SLA adherence, and driving continuous improvement across all partner engagements.

About KDDI

We are a global Top 10 telecommunications pioneer and a Global Fortune 500 company providing our international customer base with data centers, networks, content delivery, system integration, and more. We connect vehicles from several of the world's largest Automotive OEMs, as well as mobility and IoT programs across the globe. Our industry-leading Telehouse data center provides colocation at over 40 sites in 23 cities across 12 countries, including London, New York, Frankfurt, and Shanghai. Leveraging our strengths as a telecom provider, we combine IT and network expertise to deliver secure, scalable, and stress-free connectivity for our customers.

Responsibilities

    Strong understanding of KPI tracking, analytics, and performance measurement frameworks.

Soft Skills

    Strong collaboration, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

    Ability to work effectively both as a team player and an independent contributor.

Requirements

    Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

    Experience in Telecom, IT, IoT, or fast-paced technology environments is preferred.

title: Process Developer
description:
Job Title: Process Developer

Scania Credit Group (SCA), one of the captive Scania Financial Services entities, offers financing and insurance in the Middle East, Central Asia, and West Africa. SCA has become a leader in factoring solutions for non-captive dealers and body-builders, supporting Scania's goal to reduce CCC and offload its balance sheet. We have partnered with external credit insurers to mitigate commercial and political risks in certain transactions. SCA is expanding into new markets, particularly in the AMC region.

Based in Södertälje, the SCA Head Office and Market Support Centre provides governance, strategic development, credit risk management, contract administration, and IT support. With 50 employees, including 30 in Södertälje, we manage around 250 MEUR of assets across 10+ markets.

At SCA we value team spirit, diversity and respect. We believe that every employee should be able to be themselves at work. Our corporate culture is characterized by respect for the individual, continuous improvement and always putting the customer first.  

Role Summary

As a Process Developer, you will play a key role in ensuring our business applications remain reliable, efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs. Working within our Process & IT team, you will combine operational support with project work, helping to maintain critical business systems while contributing to new initiatives and digital improvements.

Reporting to the IT Manager, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across IT, Finance, Credit Risk, Risk & Compliance, Business Development, and external partners. You will be the link between business and technology, ensuring our applications continue to meet business needs while identifying opportunities to simplify processes and enhance the user experience.

This is a hands-on role where no two days are the same. One day you may be troubleshooting application issues, managing service requests, or supporting users; the next you could be coordinating testing, implementing system enhancements, participating in projects, or driving process improvements. If you enjoy solving problems, working closely with stakeholders, and making a tangible impact on how the business operates, this role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your skills within an international financial services organisation.

Job Responsibilities

    Provide first- and second-line support for business applications, troubleshooting issues and ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
    Support and administer View21 and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, including system configuration, maintenance, and enhancements.
    Coordinate application configurations and support the implementation of new products and business initiatives.
    Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), working closely with business stakeholders to validate system changes and enhancements.
    Manage user access to business applications, ensuring compliance with internal policies and supporting IT audit activities related to access, change, and incident management.
    Collaborate with business users and vendors to analyze requirements, prioritize change requests, and implement system improvements.
    Develop and maintain user guides, process documentation, and training materials to support knowledge sharing and user adoption.
    Identify opportunities to improve business processes and workflows, driving efficiency through system enhancements and process optimisation.
    Support user onboarding and offboarding by ensuring timely application provisioning, access management, and user enablement.
    Contribute to projects and improvement initiatives across the Process & IT function, balancing operational support with the delivery of new capabilities.



Who You Are

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and working closely with both business and IT stakeholders. You are curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks, whether it's resolving a support issue, coordinating testing, or driving a process improvement initiative.

You are structured and organised in your approach, able to balance operational responsibilities with project work while managing competing priorities. As a strong communicator, you build positive relationships across teams and are confident working in a collaborative environment.

Most importantly, you have a continuous improvement mindset, enjoy learning new systems and technologies, and are motivated by making a tangible impact on how the business operates.

For this position, we imagine that you will have:

    A relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience.
    3+ years of experience in application support, service management, process development, or a related IT/business systems role.
    Experience working with incident management, change management, service requests, and user support.
    Experience participating in system implementations, enhancements, testing (UAT), or continuous improvement initiatives.
    Experience with user access management, IT controls, compliance, or audit-related activities.
    Experience in financing, financial services, or a regulated business environment is highly preferred.
    Professional proficiency in English; Swedish is an advantage.
    Familiarity with View21 and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM is an advantage.
    Knowledge of Lean methodologies or the Scania Way is beneficial.
    Experience working in an international or cross-functional environment is an advantage.



This Is Us

Our Process & IT team consists of six dedicated professionals with diverse backgrounds and expertise. We are responsible for the technology and processes that enable our business to operate efficiently - from application support and infrastructure to reporting, AI and analytics, business systems, and process optimisation. Working closely with business stakeholders, we deliver practical digital solutions that create value across the organisation and support our continued growth.

At Scania Credit, we value teamwork, diversity, and respect. We believe everyone should feel empowered to be themselves at work. Our culture is built on respect for the individual, continuous improvement, and always putting the customer first.

Are you passionate about improving business processes through technology? Do you enjoy solving problems, collaborating with stakeholders, and delivering solutions that make a real business impact? If so, we'd love to hear from you. Join Scania Credit as a Process Developer and help shape the future of our business systems and digital transformation!

Scania Credit Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-17. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible. The posting may close before the application deadline if a high volume of applications is received. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
Want to be part of transforming road freight – for good? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, electric and autonomous technologies. Through freight capacity as a service, we enable businesses around the world to accelerate towards their sustainability goals.

Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a US public road. Today our award-winning technology has been launched across 8 countries (and counting). Our clients are some of the world’s biggest shippers, including Fortune 500 companies. We are also operating Sweden’s largest truck dedicated public charging network and counting.

We are now looking for a Security Engineer to join our security team!

You will:

    Build, integrate and operate our security monitoring platforms that ensure we can detect and respond to security incidents in all our environments, including user endpoints, SaaS applications, cloud infrastructure, our web platforms as well as our vehicles and charging stations.
    Be involved in security incident response when required, coordinating containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
    Build, manage and mature the vulnerability management program (including workstations, network perimeter, containers, source code, cloud configuration, etc) and build the appropriate security metrics to help drive risk-based decisions and investments.
    Build out our application security program that allows engineers to be self-empowered when appropriate and able to get assistance when required. Participate in threat modeling sessions and provide security advice in design of new and existing features.
    Collaborate with software engineers to help them improve our products’ security posture: help patch vulnerabilities, run security audits, explain complex IAM topics, brainstorm monitoring use-cases, etc

We expect you to:

    5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity or security engineering roles.
    Working experience in securing and monitoring public cloud infrastructure (e.g., ideally GCP, but any major cloud providers such as AWS or Azure work).
    Working experience in vulnerability management on multiple layers of the modern IT and software stack
    Experience with security incident management (preferably in a SOC, CDC or similar)
    Ability to code/script and automate repetitive tasks. We primarily use Go but if you have a general knack for coding, that matters more than having previous experience with a specific language.
    Great collaboration and communication skills, since you’ll be part of driving initiatives that span across the entire company.

This is a full-time position based in Stockholm or Gothenburg. You will be part of a truly diverse, high performing team with a common passion for sustainability and making things happen in an innovative way. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.

Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest.

At Einride, we are innovators, building solutions the world has never seen before – but urgently needs. That’s why we take action, and it’s why we are always eager to be challenged. We know that our best innovations come from having a diverse mix of people, including those of different experiences, career paths, and walks of life. By coming together and sharing our perspectives openly – by disagreeing, discussing, and committing – we deliver greater impact.

Born autonomous. Born electric.

Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.

We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

title: BPM & Automation Engineer (all genders), Lausanne (Industrietechnologe/-technologin - Datentechnik)

Experience with process analysis, workflow modeling and the implementation of automated business processes. Solid understanding of RESTful web services and experience working with JSON and/or XML. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. Good communication and collaboration skills, with confidence when interacting with both technical and business stakeholders. Experience with Flowable, Camunda, Appian, Appway, IBM Business Automation Workflow, UiPath or similar platforms. Familiarity with JavaScript and modern web technologies. Experience with Docker and CI/CD practices. Knowledge of Agile methods such as Scrum, Kanban or SAFe. Interest in hyperautomation, AI-supported process automation or agentic automation. Relevant certifications in Flowable, Camunda or another BPM platform.  OPPORTUNITY GIVER - WHAT MAKES ADESSO SPECIAL Our promise: You will feel at home with us!
